item.title: サッカ＝日本、エクアドルにＰＫ戦で勝利 キリンカップ
item.description: ［１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１日　ロイター］ - サッカーの日本代表は１日、横浜市の日産スタジアムでエクアドルとのキリンカップに臨み、０─０で前後半を終えた後のＰＫ戦を５─４で制した。

日本はＧＫ鈴木彩艶がエクアドルの３人目のシュートをセーブ。その一方で全員がＰＫを成功し、勝利をつかんだ。

試合後、森保一監督は「非常にいい相手と試合を組んでいただいた。高い強度とクオリティーを持つエクアドルと戦う中で、何ができて、何ができないのか、われわれがさらにレベルアップしていかなければいけない部分を確認することができた」と語った。

また、鈴木は「点を取って勝ち切りたかったが、かなり厳しい戦いだったので、守備陣としてはまず失点しないというところを意識した。自分自身も最後に止めて、勝ち切ることができたので良かった」と述べた。

キリンカップは４カ国がトーナメント形式で争う。もう１試合はニュージーランドがパナマとの１─１からのＰＫ戦を５─３で制した。

日本はこの後、５日に東京・ＭＵＦＧスタジアム（国立競技場）で行われる決勝で、ニュージーランドと対戦する。

item.title: テニス＝錦織、ジャパンＯＰ初戦敗退で現役引退 「やり切った」
item.description: ［１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１日　ロイター］ - テニスの木下グループ・ジャパン・オープン（ＯＰ）は１日、東京・有明テニスの森公園で男子シングルス１回戦を行い、主催者推薦の錦織圭（３６）が第２シードのフランシス・ティアフォー（米国）に敗れ、現役最後の大会を終えた。

錦織は４─６、４─６でストレート負け。試合後、観客からは万雷の拍手が送られた。

涙を浮かべた錦織はオンコートインタビューで、「試合が終わるまでは泣くなんて思っていなかったが、５歳からテニスを始めて、積み上げてきた３０年がここで終わっちゃうんだなと、もう本気でプレーすることはなくなるんだなという喪失感みたいなものが一気に押し寄せてきた。やはり悲しさが大きい。こういう終わり方は悔しい」と口にしつつ、「でも、やり切ったと言える思いはあるので、満足はしている」と語った。

２０１４年に四大大会の全米ＯＰで準優勝した錦織は、ツアー通算１２勝を記録。１５年３月にキャリアハイにして日本人の史上最高位となる世界ランキング４位まで上り詰め、１６年リオデジャネイロ五輪では３位で日本勢９６年ぶりのメダルを獲得した。

島袋将はデニス・シャポバロフ（カナダ）に５─７、１─６のストレートで敗れて敗退。第１シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）は、アレックス・ミケルセン（米国）に７─６、４─６、６─１で勝利した。

そのほか、第３シードのテーラー・フリッツ、第５シードのブランドン・ナカシマ（ともに米国）、第４シードのラファエル・ホダル（スペイン）、第６シードのカスパー・ルード（ノルウェー）のシード勢がそろって敗れた。

ダブルス１回戦では、上杉海斗、リンキー・ヒジカタ（オーストラリア）組がルチアーノ・ダルデリ（イタリア）、トマスマルティン・エチェベリ（アルゼンチン）組に４─６、７─５、１２─１０で逆転勝ち。望月慎太郎、渡辺聖太組は敗退した。

item.title: 米ＡＩモデル「ウエート」、中国が盗む恐れ 民主議員が警告
item.description:
Alexandra Alper
[ワシントン １日 ロイター] - 米民主党のロー・カンナ下院議員は、中国政府がオープ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＡＩモデル「ウエート」、中国が盗む恐れ　民主議員が警告 8:36 配信

オープンＡＩとアンソロピックのロゴ。6月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Alexandra Alper

[ワシントン １日 ロイター] - 米民主党のロー・カンナ下院議員は、中国政府がオープンＡＩやアンソロピックなど米主要企業が開発した人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルの「ウエート（重み）」を盗む恐れがあると警告した。ＡＩ開発競争で米国が中国に対して持つ優位性が失われ、米国の国家安全保障が脅かされる可能性があるとしている。

オープンＡＩとアンソロピックは、中国のＡＩ企業ムーンショットやディープシークなどが両社のＡＩモデルを「蒸留」、つまり欧米の先端モデルの出力結果を使って自社のツールに学習させている事例を複数報告している。一方、ＡＩモデルを動作させる具体的なパラメーターやコードであるモデルウエートを、悪意のある主体が盗み出した事例はほとんど知られていない。

下院中国特別委員会の民主党幹部であるカンナ氏は米主要ＡＩ企業に対し、中国や他の敵対勢力がモデルウエートに不正アクセスしようとした全ての既知の事例について情報を提供するよう求めた。また、窃取を防ぐために各社が講じているサイバーセキュリティー対策についても説明を求めた。

同氏はオープンＡＩ、アンソロピック、グーグル、メタ、スペースＸＡＩの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に宛てた９月３０日付の書簡で「敵対的な非国家主体が先端モデルのウエートを盗めば、人類全体が危険にさらされかねない。また、（中国）がこうしたモデルウエートを盗めば、キーボードの操作だけで米国のＡＩ分野の優位性が損なわれかねない」と指摘。

「一国の安全保障と経済の将来が、ごく少数の企業のサイバーセキュリティーにこれほど依存したことはかつてなかった」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 10/2(金) 8:36 ロイター

item.title: 米自動車販売、ＧＭ首位維持もトヨタが肉薄 ハイブリッド追い風
item.description:
Nathan Gomes Kalea Hall
[１日 ロイター] - 米国の第３・四半期新車販売台数は、ゼネラル・モ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米自動車販売、ＧＭ首位維持もトヨタが肉薄　ハイブリッド追い風 8:29 配信

米デトロイトにあるゼネラル・モーターズ（GM）本社。１月撮影。REUTERS/Rebecca Cook

Nathan Gomes　Kalea Hall

[１日 ロイター] - 米国の第３・四半期新車販売台数は、ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が首位を維持した。一方、ガソリン価格の高騰で消費者がハイブリッド車に向かう中、トヨタ自動車はＧＭとの差をさらに縮めた。

業界調査会社コックス・オートモーティブによると、「デトロイト３」と呼ばれるＧＭ、フォード・モーター、ステランティスを合わせた市場シェアは同四半期に約３６％に低下する可能性がある。一方、トヨタやホンダなどハイブリッド車の品ぞろえが豊富なアジアのブランドは、新車販売の半分以上を占める見通しだ。

イラン戦争で原油・燃料価格が高騰する中、ハイブリッド車は消費者の有力な選択肢となっている。

アナリストは、人気車種「カローラ」のハイブリッド版などをそろえるトヨタが、こうした需要の変化から最も恩恵を受けると予想している。

トヨタの第３・四半期の販売台数は全体で６３万３２２３台と小幅な増加にとどまったが、カローラのハイブリッド車は前年同期比約３６％増の１万３００３台となった。

コックスはまた、現代自動車グループが四半期ベースの米販売台数で初めてフォードを上回ると予想。第３・四半期の販売台数は現代が５１万１４２１台、フォードが５０万４１７２台になると見込んでいる。フォードは２日に四半期の販売台数を発表する予定。

＜購入負担の圧力続く＞

調査会社ＪＤパワーによると、借り入れコストは低下したものの、新車価格の上昇と下取り価格の下落で月々の支払額が増えており、コスト圧力の軽減にはほとんどつながっていない。コックスによると、８月の新車平均取引価格は前年同月比１．９％上昇し、５万００８９ドルとなった。

ＧＭはクロスオーバー車「トラックス」など手頃な価格の車種が影響を和らげたものの、第３・四半期の販売台数は全体で５．５％減の６７万０９７４台となった。

同社の電気自動車（ＥＶ）販売も前年同期比６２％減少した。前年同期は２０２５年９月の７５００ドルの連邦税額控除終了を前にした駆け込み購入で需要が押し上げられていた。その後、業界全体でＥＶ販売が急減している。

ホンダの第３・四半期販売台数は前年同期比９％増加した。

ステランティスは３２万４２７７台と、前年同期からほぼ横ばいだった。

コックスの推計では、第３・四半期の米自動車販売は全体で約４１０万台と、前年同期比約１％減少する見込みだ。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：トヨタ自動車、ＨＶ技術活用で再び成長軌道へ アングル：ＧＭもアウディも、中国に開発委ねる自動車大手　狙いはＥＶやソフトの技術力 アングル：米自動車メーカー広告は「愛国モード全開」、Ｗ杯と建国250年重複で 焦点：米政権とカリフォルニア州のＥＶ法廷闘争、自動車メーカーを翻弄 アングル：米ＥＶ市場、税控除終了で崩壊の恐れ　各社が対応急ぐ 最終更新: 10/2(金) 8:29 ロイター

item.title: Fed's Logan calls for '50 bps or more' in rate hikes
item.description: The US central bank will need to raise short-term borrowing costs by at least another half of a percentage point to turn monetary policy "modestly restrictive" and get inflation back on track to the Federal Reserve's 2% goal, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Ann Saphir
item.content:encoded: The US central bank will need to raise short-term borrowing costs by at least another half of a percentage point to turn monetary policy "modestly restrictive" and get inflation back on track to the Federal Reserve's 2% goal, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday. The Fed's quarter-point policy rate increase last month, to its current range of 3.75%-4.00%, was "an important first step" in tightening policy, Logan said in remarks prepared for Texas business executives and community leaders at the regional Fed bank's headquarters. "Still, I currently estimate the target range needs to rise an additional 50 basis points or more to appropriately balance the outlook and risks for our dual mandate goals," she said. "We must restore price stability." The economy is strengthening and the labor market is well balanced, she said. And though inflation is falling as transitory factors fade, it does not look like it will go much lower than 2.5% without further rate hikes. "A few additional increases in the target range would undo the FOMC’s risk management cuts from last fall," Logan said, referring to the Fed's policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee, which cut the policy rate 75 basis points over the final three meetings of last year. Logan's remarks came on a day that the benchmark 10-year Treasury note yield touched a 24-year high before falling back to around 5.24%. Higher long-term bond yields show market participants expect strong economic growth and a higher Fed policy rate, Logan said, though they may also reflect higher term premiums, which "can slow the economy, reducing the need to tighten monetary policy." The exact level of the policy rate that will be needed to create some restriction is uncertain, she said, and changes over time depending on the broader financial environment. "I will continue to watch labor markets, prices, growth, consumption and financial conditions to evaluate whether policy is becoming restrictive."

item.title: G20 trade chiefs to denounce food trade coercion but not excess factory capacity
item.description: G20 trade ministers agreed on Thursday to denounce the weaponization of food through coercive trade actions, but failed to reach consensus on statements denouncing forced labor in supply chains and on addressing structural excess industrial capacity, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: G20 trade ministers agreed on Thursday to denounce the weaponization of food through coercive trade actions, but failed to reach consensus on statements denouncing forced labor in supply chains and on addressing structural excess industrial capacity, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said. Greer told a news conference that many of the G20 trade ministers meeting in Milwaukee expressed concerns about excess industrial capacity, particularly in China, that is flooding their markets with cheap exports. "Nearly all countries agree that this is an issue that requires action, and nearly all countries agree that our current system of trade remedies or responses is inadequate to solve this problem," Greer said, adding that is why the US has taken unilateral tariff action to protect its industries. He did not name countries objecting, but [USN:L1N44T0JC TEXT:"China had objected"] to a similar G20 statement denouncing forced labor and non-market economic policies that lead to excessive exports at a finance leaders' meeting a month ago in Asheville, North Carolina. "In the United States, we will continue to have discussions on this topic with like-minded trading partners well beyond Milwaukee," Greer said. The G20 ministers also discussed a US proposal for a sweeping reform of the Most Favored Nation system of published unconditional tariff rates that has underpinned global trade since the end of World War Two. This is a new topic for the G20, as past discussions on MFN tariffs have taken place within the World Trade Organization. Greer said the US did not propose a joint G20 statement on MFN tariff reform because it was a longer-term conversation that was important to start. "So for us, we think that the principle of unconditional Most Favored Nation (tariffs) warrants reform," Greer said. "We think that it actually fails to promote reciprocity and balance in the trading system. It can actually create free riders." The G20 is expected to release a joint statement denouncing food coercion later on Thursday. EXPORT PRESSURE European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic told reporters separately that he was enthusiastic about discussing the need for "concentrated action" to tackle excess capacity because the problem has exploded over the past decade to the point where exports from China are threatening key industries in Europe, including autos and steel. "Now we are at the stage where, because of these overcapacities and turbulence on the global market, (it) can create such flooding of the markets that whole sectors could be put in danger within a couple weeks or months," he told reporters. China, a G20 member, has rejected claims that its industrial policies have created excess capacity, and accuses Western countries of using the issue to justify protectionist measures. Greer also said that he had positive discussions with French, German and other European counterparts about cooperation to open up strategic diesel reserves to help push down high prices due to supply constraints. "I think I won't put words in their mouth, of course, but I think they would love to have a cooperative path forward with the United States on how we get more diesel to market. Getting some of that diesel that's in the reserve is part of that equation." He declined to directly address a [USN:L6N45N0FO TEXT:"Reuters report"] that US officials have warned France and Germany that they face a potential US diesel export ban if they fail to release emergency stocks of the fuel.

item.title: 中国製油各社、10月の燃料輸出停止 国内在庫確保へ＝関係筋
item.description:
Trixie Yap Siyi Liu Chen Aizhu
[シンガポール １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trixie Yap　Siyi Liu　Chen Aizhu

[シンガポール １日 ロイター] - 中国の製油各社が１０月の石油製品輸出を停止したことが、関係者４人の話で分かった。政府が国内在庫の確保を優先しているためで、イラン戦争で供給が制約されている世界の燃料市場が一段と逼迫することになる。

中国政府はイラン戦争による原油供給の混乱を受け、３月に燃料輸出を制限。７月に規制を緩和し、ディーゼル（軽油）、ガソリン、ジェット燃料の出荷を月単位で管理してきた。しかし関係者によると、１日からの大型連休前に主要製油各社に対し香港・マカオ以外への輸出許可を出さなかった。連休明けの７日以降に許可が再開されるかは不透明で、国内在庫や精製量次第となる可能性がある。

中国国家発展改革委員会はコメントの要請に直ちに応じなかった。

関係者によると、国有大手の中国石油天然ガス（ペトロチャイナ）は９月３０日、１０月に予定していたガソリンとジェット燃料の出荷を一部取り消した。浙江石油化工は連休中の出荷を予定していない。

中国政府は在庫が戦争前の水準に戻ることを輸出の条件としている。データ会社ケプラーによると、商業用軽油在庫は輸出再開の基準を約２０００万バレル、ガソリンは約９００万バレル下回っている。

オックスフォード・エネルギー研究所の中国エネルギー調査責任者ミハル・メイダン氏は「政府の重点が依然として国内供給の安全確保にあることを浮き彫りにした。国際市場は二の次だ」と述べた。

世界の燃料供給はイラン戦争に加え、ウクライナによるロシア製油施設への攻撃でも減少している。中国の輸出停止観測を受け、アジアの軽油スワップの１０月限と１１月限のスプレッドは２週間ぶりの高水準となった。韓国の製油各社が不足分の一部を補う可能性はあるが、長期契約によりスポット供給量は限られるという。

今回の輸出停止に先立ち、中国の習近平国家主席はワシントンを訪問し、トランプ米大統領から世界の燃料供給安定化に協力するよう求められていた。

item.title: From cyber to Middle East, US and allies take stark lessons from 2026
item.description: As America's military cyberdefence professionals met for their annual trade meeting in Maryland last Thursday, several top US commanders issued a blunt warning that sustained operations this year had cost the US much of its long-built-up advantages in cyberspace.
item.dc:creator: Peter Apps
item.content:encoded: As America's military cyberdefence professionals met for their annual trade meeting in Maryland last Thursday, several top US commanders issued a blunt warning that sustained operations this year had cost the US much of its long-built-up advantages in cyberspace. According to US officials, highly sophisticated cyberattacks were at the heart of operations earlier this year, firstly to capture Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and then to degrade Iranian sensors and communications in the first days of the US-led "Operation Epic Fury". Those operations, US officials say, were initially very successful, blinding hostile systems and enabling US forces to strike physical targets much more safely. Over time, however, senior officials told the gathering of the Military Cyber Professionals Association, known as Hammercon, their ability to conduct offensive cyberattacks through pre-identified vulnerabilities in hostile systems has begun eroding fast. "Your cyber magazine of these exquisite fires is empty pretty damn quick," Vice Admiral Heidi Berg, commander of the US Navy Fleet Cyber Command, said in response to a question, referring to the abilities to hack and frustrate or turn off key systems in an opposing nation. At other events this year, senior US officials have called on the US defence industry to find new ways of using cyber and electronic warfare to deter and, if necessary, defeat major US adversaries, particularly China. But the reality, insiders say, is that finding such vulnerabilities takes considerable time and effort – and conducting direct attacks prompts immediate adaptation by the other side. That, Vice Admiral Berg said, raised serious questions for future long campaigns. "How are you going to regenerate and continue to develop access and effects... over the course of what will almost always be... a sustained conflict?" she said, according to a report of the event on specialist website Breaking Defense. According to Lieutenant General Christopher Eubank, head of US Army Cyber Command speaking at the same event, demand for direct US cyber support to wider military operations had been "constant" since the conflict with Iran began on February 28. He said that this was the "first time for the cyber force at large" that operations have been at such a tempo. Those lessons in cyberspace – which had not been widely reported before the Military Cyber Professionals Association event last week – appear to overlap heavily with much wider trends – particularly the overuse of precision missiles, including those for air defence. At the start of August, multiple US military sources told Reuters the Pentagon had [USN:L1N4410KB TEXT:"used up large stockpiles"] of ATACMS strike missiles, Patriot air defence systems and Tomahawk long-range cruise missiles, to the point that it would take multiple years to rebuild "magazine depth". The strain has also been telling on other parts of the US military. Last week, US Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao confirmed in a letter to Congress that eight sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier had attempted suicide during its unusually long 286 consecutive days at sea this year supporting operations in the Middle East. QUARTER OF US REAPER DRONE FLEET DESTROYED This year’s high US military operational tempo – not just in the Gulf, but also including ongoing military drills and posturing in the Pacific against an increasingly aggressive China, as well as around the conflict in Ukraine – has delivered a stark challenge to the Pentagon. On one level, events this year have acted as a savage and robust reminder of US military strength – no other nation could come close to conducting such operations, particularly with such a low number of friendly casualties: 19 US dead, according to the primary Pentagon count, roughly equally divided between accidents and direct Iranian strikes. On another, however, they have shown the stark limits of that power – and the damage to the US military inventory goes well beyond just the used up missile stocks. According to US specialist defence media reports, the US Air Force has lost as many as 40 of its MQ-9 Reaper drones in its operations since the end of February, as much as a quarter of its total airworthy fleet. “Although we have plenty... today, we are going through them at a rate that is concerning to us," US Air Force chief modernisation officer Lieutenant General Christopher Niemi told reporters at the Pentagon earlier this month, saying the US was now pushing manufacturers to get a much cheaper alternative to the up to $50 million Reaper into service as fast as possible. Other aircraft losses have also been on a scale unseen in recent US wars, including two KC-135 tankers destroyed and another seven damaged, a wrecked E-3 Sentry airborne warning aircraft, four destroyed F-15E Strike Eagles and another eight damaged. Two MC-130J gunships and an A-10 Warthog were also lost on a mission to retrieve a downed pilot. Those manned aircraft losses remain only a tiny fraction of total US strength – the US Air Force currently fields more than 200 combat-F-15s, with the US and its allies also now operating in excess of 1,000 of the much more capable F-35. Last week, the carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt departed San Diego for the Middle East, another reminder of ongoing US reach. Still, estimates from the Congressional Budget Office put the financial expense of “Epic Fury” so far as just under $40 billion, pointedly warning it would take several years to rebuild depleted stocks of interceptor missiles critical for deterring any future war with China. This week, US military publication Stars and Stripes noted that the US was moving to store long-range Typhon and High Mobility Artillery Rocket System missiles at Kadena Air Force Base in Okinawa. That move was announced jointly with Japan and likely intended to reassure US regional allies and remind Beijing that, despite a largely friendly meeting between US President Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping, the US remains ready to fight a war if needed. A new generation of unmanned weaponry, including maritime drones, might redress the balance in favour of the US and its allies – but they are taking time to enter service. ALLIES FEAR OVERSTRETCH, US TROOPS RETURN TO EUROPE When it comes to supporting allies this year, the US record has been distinctly mixed – with Saudi Arabia, in particular, now turning to wider foreign help despite the presence of what Gulf media say have been more than 100 US advisers on the ground. According to French President Emmanuel Macron, French troops and missiles are now helping protect the Saudi port of Yanbu, while Riyadh is also publicly discussing further support with treaty allies Pakistan and Turkey. On Monday, Japanese Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi suggested Japan now needed to move past the "taboo" on discussing whether it might need atomic weapons, a discussion that has also quietly become increasingly widespread in South Korea and Poland. Russian missiles, meanwhile, continue to pound Ukrainian targets, now helped by a lack of US-manufactured interceptors. And whatever the truth behind the apparent incident at RAF Fairford earlier this week, it comes following a rising number of sabotage and drone incidents across much of eastern Europe and warnings from intelligence agencies of likely more to come. This summer, the US quietly withdrew troop detachments forward deployed in the Baltic states – but last week saw announcements that some would return, including a pair of tank and engineering battle groups to Lithuania. It was also announced that a small armoured force would again be based in Estonia throughout the coming winter. That might just suggest a broader shift – a re-learning of lessons, an acknowledgement that sometimes a simple forward deployment of US forces can deter aggressive action – and the realisation that launching conflict is much easier to do than managing the resulting fallout. But it will be a work in progress. On one panel at the Military Cyber Professionals event last week, US Air Force Captain Corey Jones reflected that part of becoming a junior leader was learning to shape the expectations of superiors over what was truly possible. "Things move superfast," he said. "Just getting the resources that we need to do our job is hard. We are consistently asked to do more with less."

item.title: 49ers sign WR Brandin Cooks to active roster
item.description: The wide receiver-needy San Francisco 49ers signed Brandin Cooks from their practice squad to the active roster Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The wide receiver-needy San Francisco 49ers signed Brandin Cooks from their practice squad to the active roster Thursday. In other moves, the Niners signed wide receiver Malik Turner to the practice squad while releasing receiver KhaDarel Hodge with an injury settlement. The 49ers signed the veteran Cooks to the practice squad on Sept. 22 as they faced a growing list of injuries at the position. Ricky Pearsall (knee), Demarcus Robinson (high ankle sprain), De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle surgery) and Christian Kirk (calf) are currently on injured reserve. Stribling went down in Week 1 and Robinson was hurt in Week 2. Mike Evans, one of their marquee offseason additions, picked up a hip injury in Week 2, played through it in Week 3 and then suffered what multiple reports deemed a rib strain. And Brandon Aiyuk is on the reserve/left squad list amid his standoff with the team. Cooks, 33, spent last season with the New Orleans Saints and Buffalo Bills and is beginning his 13th NFL season with his seventh club. He appeared in 15 games last season for New Orleans and Buffalo, catching 24 passes for 279 yards. In the divisional round of the playoffs, he was at the center of a controversial late-game call in which he appeared to make a catch before Denver Broncos cornerback Ja'Quan McMillian wrestled the ball away from him. The play was ruled an interception. A first-round pick by the Saints in 2014, Cooks has also suited up for the New England Patriots, Los Angeles Rams, Houston Texans and Dallas Cowboys. He has 734 career receptions for 9,811 yards and 60 touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: Lula tem 48% e Flávio Bolsonaro tem 45% em potencial segundo turno da eleição presidencial, diz Datafolha
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) registra 48% das intenções de voto em um eventual segundo turno da disputa presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), que angaria 45%, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) registra 48% das intenções de voto em um eventual segundo turno da disputa presidencial contra o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), que angaria 45%, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira. Na sondagem da semana passada, a vantagem numérica de Lula sobre Flávio era de 47% a 45%. Os dois seguem em empate técnico, uma vez que a margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos. A pesquisa também apurou que no cenário de primeiro turno, Lula conta com 42% -- ante 40% na semana passada --, e Flávio tem 38%, ante 36% na última rodada.

item.title: New Mexico wants Meta to pay up to $40 billion in penalties after data privacy trial
item.description: The state of New Mexico asked a judge on Thursday to order Meta Platforms to pay between $35 billion and $40 billion in penalties after a jury found the company had misled consumers about the privacy of their data on Facebook in a case that came out of the Cambridge Analytica scandal.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: The state of New Mexico asked a judge on Thursday to order Meta Platforms (META.O) to pay between $35 billion and $40 billion in penalties after a jury found the company had [USN:L6N45F10O TEXT:"misled consumers"] about the privacy of their data on Facebook in a case that came out of the Cambridge Analytica scandal. Attorneys for New Mexico made the request at a hearing in a lawsuit brought following revelations that the British political consulting firm, which worked on Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign, harvested personal data from as many as 87 million Facebook users through a third-party app without their consent. The jury returned its verdict on September 25. Judge Francis Mathew, who oversaw the trial in Santa Fe, will decide how much Meta must pay in financial penalties. Attorneys for Meta and New Mexico clashed at the hearing over how much was appropriate to order, with Meta arguing that the penalties the state was seeking don't match the conduct the state focused its case on at trial. "Well, when the parties go to trial, they roll the dice," said Mathew. "They have to accept the consequences of their decision to go to trial, do they not?" TRIAL FOCUSED ON MISSTATEMENTS The lawsuit, filed in 2021, accused Meta of lying to Facebook users in the state about who had access to their data, how the company handles hate speech and misinformation posted on the platform and other internal policies. The company knew that third parties had broad access to users' personal data, and it tolerated hate speech or other harmful content when it benefited the company's bottom line, the state said. Jurors examined 29 statements made by the company and its leadership on those issues and found 26 of them misleading. They said the company had committed more than 43 million violations of New Mexico’s consumer protection laws, based on the number of Facebook users or New Mexico residents who were the audience for each misleading statement. Attorneys for Meta had argued at trial that the statements were cherry-picked snippets, and the company had repeatedly acknowledged its handling of misinformation or privacy issues was not perfect. State law allows the judge to decide how much to fine Meta per violation, up to $5,000. At the hearing on Thursday, Randi McGinn, a lawyer for New Mexico, said applying the full $5,000 penalty to the number of violations would create too large of a penalty under the US Constitution’s protections on due process. But the judge should order a significant payment that will impact the company, McGinn said. "This court should speak to Meta in the only language it understands, which is money, and the value of its stock price," McGinn said. She said $35 billion to $40 billion, which represents about 20% of the possible penalties that could be awarded under state law from the verdict, would impact the stock price while complying with Meta's right to due process under the Constitution. At the hearing on Thursday, Matt Nicholson, a lawyer for Meta, called the state's request an "astronomical penalty that would obviously violate a host of constitutional provisions." In court filings, Meta urged Mathew to cap the penalties at $3.45 billion. The jury may have said it found Meta’s statements misleading, but the evidence shows that Meta does not sell user data and New Mexico did not prove that any consumer had actually been misled, the company said in court filings. The judge said he expected to issue a ruling later this month. The case is State of New Mexico, et. al., v. Meta Platforms, Inc., case number D-101-CV-2021-00132 in the First Judicial District Court of New Mexico. For New Mexico: Randi McGinn of McGinn Montoya Love Curry & Sievers For Meta: Matt Nicholson of Williams & Connolly

item.title: FMI aprueba US$139 millones para El Salvador tras exención por incumplimiento sobre bitcoin
item.description: El FMI concedió una exención a El Salvador por incumplir una condición sobre la acumulación de bitcoins y pidió al gobierno de Nayib Bukele detener nuevas compras de la criptomoneda.
item.dc:creator: Michael McDonald, Matthew Bristow
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El Fondo Monetario Internacional ha aprobado un desembolso de US$139 millones a El Salvador tras conceder una exención por el incumplimiento por parte del gobierno de una condición que limitaba la acumulación adicional de bitcoins. El Consejo de Administración del FMI completó su segunda y tercera revisiones en el marco del Servicio Ampliado del Fondo de US$1.400 millones concedido al país, lo que permite la liberación inmediata de los fondos. Vea más: El Salvador cambia su apuesta cripto: Bukele recurre a stablecoins tras limitado uso del bitcoin en pagos La actividad económica ha superado las expectativas, respaldada por la mejora de la seguridad y el aumento de la confianza de los inversores, según ha señalado el Fondo en un comunicado. Se prevé que la economía crezca un 4,5% este año y un 4% en 2027. No obstante, el FMI instó al gobierno del presidente Nayib Bukele a detener la acumulación adicional de bitcoins y a seguir reduciendo la participación del Estado en las criptomonedas. “No se cumplieron determinados criterios de desempeño, entre ellos los relativos a la acumulación de bitcoins, para lo cual se concedieron exenciones basadas en sólidas medidas correctivas y compromisos renovados”, señaló el Fondo. “No se prevé ninguna acumulación adicional de bitcoins más allá de las donaciones documentadas”. El Salvador convirtió al bitcoin en moneda de curso legal junto con el dólar estadounidense en 2021, aunque su adopción siguió siendo limitada. No obstante, el gobierno acumuló una reserva considerable de esta criptomoneda. El FMI señaló que el gobierno también ha transferido la propiedad mayoritaria y el control de su monedero de criptomonedas “Chivo” a un operador privado y que debería liquidar por completo su exposición restante. “De cara al futuro, el programa seguirá centrándose en reforzar la sostenibilidad fiscal, reconstruir los colchones externos, mejorar la resiliencia del sector financiero, impulsar las reformas de gobernanza y transparencia, y apoyar un crecimiento más sólido e inclusivo”, afirmó el FMI. -Con la colaboración de Jorgelina do Rosario. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: 世界のＭ＆Ａ、第3四半期は41％減 年初来では高水準維持
item.description:
Anousha Sakoui Echo Wang
[ロンドン／ニューヨーク １日 ロイター] - 世界の企業合併・買...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
世界のＭ＆Ａ、第3四半期は41％減　年初来では高水準維持 8:10 配信

バンカ・モンテ・デイ・パスキ・ディ・シエナの前で2016年1月撮影。 REUTERS/Max Rossi

Anousha Sakoui　Echo Wang

[ロンドン／ニューヨーク １日 ロイター] - 世界の企業合併・買収（Ｍ＆Ａ）は２０２６年第３・四半期の取引総額が９９３０億ドルとなり、第２・四半期から４１％減少した。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、四半期の取引額が１兆ドルを下回るのは２５年第２・四半期以来。

第３・四半期に発表された１００億ドルを超える大型案件は１０件にとどまり、２４年第４・四半期以来の低水準となった。１００億ドル超の案件には、イタリアの銀行バンカ・モンテ・デイ・パスキ・ディ・シエナによるバンコＢＰＭ への３２０億ドルの買収提案や、南アフリカの産金大手ゴールド・フィールズ による豪ノーザン・スター・リソーシズ への２５７億ドルの買収提案などが含まれる。

ただ年初からの世界のＭ＆Ａは、案件数こそ８％減少したものの、取引総額は前年同期比２８％増の３兆９０００億ドルと、０１年以来の高水準となった。

ゴールドマン・サックスで欧州・中東・アフリカ地域のＭ＆Ａ共同責任者を務めるカーステン・ウォーン氏は「企業は引き続き規模の拡大と、自社が進出していない市場、技術へのアクセスを求めている」と指摘。現在のペースが続けば、年間のＭ＆Ａ総額は２１年の過去最高を上回るとの見通しを示した。

同氏は「大型案件は続いており、夏以降も目立った動きが見られる。企業の取締役会では、戦略的な案件を実行する必要性が一段と強く認識されている」と述べた。

テクノロジー分野への歴史的な規模の投資もＭ＆Ａを支えている。今年これまでの世界のＭ＆Ａの約４分の１を、テクノロジー企業への戦略的な出資が占めた。今年に入り、対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を手がけるアンソロピックと、「チャットＧＰＴ」を開発するオープンＡＩはいずれも投資家から数百億ドルを調達した。

米国と欧州のＭ＆Ａが第３・四半期に大幅に減少したのに対し、アジア太平洋地域の取引額は２４２０億ドルと、第２・四半期比８％増、前年同期比では３６％増加した。

また年初からのプライベートエクイティー（ＰＥ）関連の世界のＭ＆Ａは、金額ベースで統計をさかのぼれる１９８０年以来の最高水準となった。ただ第３・四半期に限ると前年同期から減速した。国境をまたぐクロスボーダーＭ＆Ａも活発で、年初からの取引額は前年同期比３２％増加した。

ＪＰモルガンのＭ＆Ａグローバル責任者チャーリー・ブーカート氏は「ドル高を生かし、これまで欧州での買収を検討してこなかった米企業の間にも相応の意欲が見られる。逆に、より高い成長機会を求めて米国への投資を検討する動きもある」と解説した。

新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の活発化もＭ＆Ａを後押ししており、特にテクノロジー企業では、上場によって得た株式という新たな買収手段を使い、競合企業を取り込む動きが出ている。米宇宙開発企業スペースＸ はナスダック市場への大型上場で企業価値が２兆ドルを超えた数日後、ＡＩを活用したコーディングサービスを手がける新興企業カーソルを買収した。

モルガン・スタンレーのＭ＆Ａグローバル責任者ジョン・コリンズ氏は「企業規模を拡大することで、ＡＩを巡る変化によりうまく対応できる可能性があることが、Ｍ＆Ａを促す要因の１つになっている」と述べた。

スペースＸが６月に実施したＩＰＯなどを背景に、年初から世界で実施されたＩＰＯによる調達額は、特別買収目的会社（ＳＰＡＣ）を除いて２１５０億ドルに達した。案件数は前年同期を下回ったものの、調達額は２１年以来の高水準となった。

第３・四半期の株式発行による調達額は２８４０億ドル。第２・四半期の世界の株式資本市場での調達額に比べ２６％減少したが、２５年第３・四半期からは３９％増えた。韓国ＳＫハイニックスや米インテルによる株式売り出しなどが寄与した。

一方、一部の銀行関係者からは、テクノロジーやＡＩ関連の案件に対して投資家が慎重になり始めているとの声も出ている。ＢＮＰパリバで株式資本市場のグローバル責任者を務めるアンドレアス・ベルンストルフ氏は「１０日ほど前までは中間選挙を気にしている人はほとんどいなかったが、軽油価格や金利が上昇し、政治の方向性が変わるリスクもあるため、慎重姿勢が強まっている」と述べた。

それでもＪＰモルガンのブーカート氏は「ＡＩなどの強力な長期トレンドが案件をけん引しており、２７年も活発な年になると予想している」と先行きに自信を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：武田薬のシャイアー買収5年、大型Ｍ＆Ａの難しさ示す アングル：中国発ＳＨＥＩＮ、買収主導で増収率の回復狙う アングル：英企業対象のＭ＆Ａ、年初来総額が1920億ドルと記録的な急増 焦点：訂正-焦点：高値の提案も拒否可能、経産省が買収指針明確化　同意なき買収にどう影響 アングル：日本のＭ＆Ａで増す株主の存在感、経営判断の「その後」も意識 最終更新: 10/2(金) 8:10 ロイター

item.title: ソフトバンクＧ、オープンＡＩに300億ドル出資完了 持ち分13％に
item.description: [東京 ２日 ロイター] - ソフトバンクグループは１日、対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「チャットＧＰＴ」を手掛ける米オー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ソフトバンクＧ、オープンＡＩに300億ドル出資完了　持ち分13％に 8:08 配信

２０２５年２月、東京で行われたイベントで登壇するソフトバンクの孫正義氏とオープンAIのサム・アルトマン氏。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ２日 ロイター] - ソフトバンクグループは１日、対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「チャットＧＰＴ」を手掛ける米オープンＡＩに３００億ドル追加出資する計画について、第３弾となる１００億ドルを払い込み、全て完了したと発表した。累計出資額は６４６億ドル（１０兆円超）、持ち分は約１３％となった。

「ソフトバンク・ビジョン・ファンド２」を通じて３回に分けて実施した。今回出資した１００億ドルは９月に発表した外貨建て社債の発行で得た資金を充てた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 10/2(金) 8:08 ロイター

item.title: UK commits £80 million to accelerate dementia diagnosis
item.description: The UK's national research agency is backing a plan to speed up dementia testing with up to £80 million ($105.48 million) in funding, to improve diagnosis rates and cut waiting times that can exceed a year.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The UK's national research agency is backing a plan to speed up dementia testing with up to £80 million ($105.48 million) in funding, to improve diagnosis rates and cut waiting times that can exceed a year. Here are more details: UK Research and Innovation, or UKRI, said on Friday nine new technologies — including faster brain scans, blood tests and a 15-minute remote cognitive test — will be trialled in the National Health Service. The project aims to diagnose 92% of patients within 18 weeks of referral, up from about 60% now. One of the projects seeks to shorten MRI brain scans to about seven minutes from around 20, which would allow more patients to be scanned and lower costs, UKRI said. Other projects include an artificial intelligence tool to predict how the disease will progress, digital tools to track changes in memory and thinking, and a home sensor system to help doctors step in earlier. Only projects that demonstrate benefits in NHS testing will receive additional funding — an approach UKRI calls "fail-fast", designed to speed up adoption of effective technologies. "Dementia has been neglected for far too long," Minister of State for Health Karin Smyth said. "More people die as a consequence of dementia than any other disease in the United Kingdom, accounting for almost one in eight deaths," said UKRI Health Mission Challenge Director Andy Hill, adding that over 72,000 people across the UK died from dementia, including Alzheimer's disease, last year. ($1 = 0.7584 pounds)

item.title: Quadria-backed Maxivision confidentially files for India IPO
item.description: India's Maxivision Super Specialty Eye Hospitals, backed by healthcare-focused buyout firm Quadria Capital, has confidentially filed for an initial public offering, a newspaper advertisement showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Maxivision Super Specialty Eye Hospitals, backed by healthcare-focused buyout firm Quadria Capital, has confidentially filed for an initial public offering, a newspaper advertisement showed on Friday. Reuters had reported in July that the eye-care chain had [USN:L4N43F0GT TEXT:"appointed"] ICICI Securities and IIFL Capital as bankers for an IPO that would include a mix of newly issued shares and stock sold by existing investors. India's confidential filing mechanism allows companies to submit draft IPO papers to the market regulator without public disclosure, keeping financial and operational details private while seeking regulatory approval. Founded in 1996, Maxivision operates more than 90 centres across six states, and competes with chains including Dr. Agarwal's Health Care (DRAA.NS) , Centre for Sight and ASG Eye Hospitals. India's eye-care market is projected to grow to $31.2 billion by 2033 from $12.8 billion in 2025, according to Grand View Research.

item.title: US alleges California man smuggled export-controlled servers to China
item.description: A California man was arrested on federal charges alleging he smuggled to China more than $300 million worth of export-controlled computer servers containing US-manufactured graphics processing units commonly used for AI applications, the US Justice Department said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: A California man was arrested on federal charges alleging he smuggled to China more than $300 million worth of export-controlled computer servers containing US-manufactured graphics processing units commonly used for AI applications, the US Justice Department said on Thursday. DETAILS AND QUOTES: Greg Lui, 38, also known as "Yiu Kong Lui," of San Gabriel, California, was expected to make his initial appearance and be arraigned on Friday in the US District Court in downtown Los Angeles, the Department of Justice said. Lui was charged with one count of conspiracy to violate the Export Control Reform Act and the Export Administration Regulations, one count of outbound smuggling, and one count of conspiracy to commit money laundering, the DOJ said. The case is the latest in a series of federal prosecutions that target the alleged smuggling of advanced American computing technology to China, as Washington seeks to prevent Beijing from acquiring chips that could strengthen its military capabilities. Lui owns Earthmade Computer, a technology company and closely held corporation, the Justice Department said. Lui could not be reached for comment. Earthmade Computer did not immediately respond to a request for comment. From 2023 to 2024, Lui and his co-conspirators used Earthmade to buy and send export-controlled items to China without the required licenses issued by the US Department of Commerce, the Justice Department added. The DOJ alleged they shipped these items to countries such as Malaysia and Singapore, where no such license is required and then illegally re-exported them to China.

item.title: 独政府、26・27年成長予測引き上げ イラン戦争の影響限定的
item.description:
Holger Hansen
[ベルリン １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Holger Hansen

[ベルリン １日 ロイター] - ドイツ政府が２０２６年と２７年の経済成長率予測を引き上げたことが、関係者の話で１日分かった。イラン戦争による経済への悪影響が懸念したほど大きくないことが背景にある。

２６年の成長率予測は１．３％、２７年は１．１％に引き上げた。４月時点ではそれぞれ０．５％、０．９％を見込んでいた。２８年については０．６％と予測している。

９月の州議会選挙では経済の低迷がメルツ首相にとって弱点となり、極右と極左が大きく躍進しただけに、景気回復は同氏にとって歓迎すべき動きとなる。

経済省は今月８日に新たな予測を正式に発表する。同省はコメントを控えた。

イラン紛争に伴う物価上昇や米国の関税政策による不透明感にもかかわらず、ドイツ経済は底堅さを示しており、第２・四半期の成長率は前期比０．３％となった。

回復をけん引しているのは、借り入れを財源とする政府のインフラ投資や軍備増強だ。

輸出も成長をけん引する見通しだ。関係者によると、政府は２６年の輸出の伸びを３．７％と予測。その後、伸び率は２７年に２．１％、２８年に１．１％へ鈍化すると見込む。

＜インフレは加速＞

中東の戦争は、特にガソリンや軽油価格の高騰を通じたインフレという形で、多くの消費者に影響を及ぼしている。

関係者によると、政府はインフレ率が２６年に２．７％、２７年に３．０％に達した後、２８年には２．２％に鈍化すると予測している。

ドイツ連邦統計庁が今週発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）速報値は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）基準（ＨＩＣＰ）で前年比３．３％上昇し、２０２３年１２月以来の高水準となった。

メルツ政権は、イラン戦争で急騰した燃料価格に対応するため、１０月から１２月末までガソリンと軽油にかかる税金を１リットル当たり０．１７ユーロ（０．２０ドル）引き下げる。

item.title: Pilots of crashed Amazon cargo plane were unaware of wind conditions
item.description: The pilots of a Miami-based 21 Air cargo plane operating for Amazon.com that crashed in Miami last month killing five people, were unaware of wind conditions, the National Transportation Safety Board said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The pilots of a Miami-based 21 Air cargo plane operating for Amazon.com that crashed in Miami last month killing five people, were unaware of wind conditions, the National Transportation Safety Board said on Thursday. The NTSB's preliminary report is the first detailed account of the September 6 crash and points to a series of likely failures — from excessive speed and unused braking systems to missing wind information from an air traffic controller — that may have led to one of the deadliest US runway accidents in years. The 21 Air-operated cargo flight for Amazon Air, which is Amazon's cargo logistics network, overran a runway while landing at Miami International Airport and struck two vehicles on the ground. Amazon has since paused use of 21 Air. The NTSB said a Federal Aviation Administration air traffic controller issued a landing clearance, but did not provide information on the wind as required by the FAA. About four minutes before issuing the landing clearance, when asked by another flight for wind information, the controller stated winds were from 190° at 19 knots with gusts to 22 knots. The 21 Air flight was not on the radio frequency at the time, the NTSB said. The FAA did not immediately comment. The aircraft was a 32-year-old Boeing (BA.N) 767-300 freighter that had previously operated as a passenger jet for various airlines from 1994 to 2015. The NTSB said the captain of the 21 Air-operated plane considered aborting the landing after the aircraft touched down, citing evidence from a flight data recorder. The NTSB said the first officer cautioned the captain they were flying "too fast" just over a minute before touching down on the runway that they overran and made additional comments about the airplane’s excessive speed. The NTSB said the captain did not verbally acknowledge all of the first officer's comments about speed. The NTSB said data showed the speed brakes remained stowed and the thrust reversers did not deploy during the landing. The airplane touched down about 3,750 feet (1143 meter) past the start of the runway at a groundspeed of 160 knots (184mph). The cargo plane was on its third flight of the day, coming from San Juan, Puerto Rico. It had flown from Cincinnati to Miami and from Miami to San Juan earlier before the crash. Amazon said it remains committed to supporting the NTSB’s ongoing investigation. 21 Air said its "executive leadership team is actively engaged in managing operational risk and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement." The company added it is reviewing the NTSB preliminary report and "will take all appropriate action to improve our safety based on the facts as they are established.”

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro anuncia que não irá ao debate da TV Globo
item.description: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), principal adversário do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) na disputa eleitoral, anunciou que não vai mais participar do debate dos presidenciáveis na TV Globo nesta quinta-feira, poucas horas antes de seu início.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), principal adversário do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) na disputa eleitoral, anunciou que não vai mais participar do debate dos presidenciáveis na TV Globo nesta quinta-feira, poucas horas antes de seu início. Em publicação no X, Flávio justificou a decisão pelo que chamou de "censura imposta ao evento" pelo Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). Pouco antes, decisão do TSE determinou que a emissora não poderia mostrar o púlpito vazio de Lula, que havia anunciado há dias que não participaria do debate.

item.title: Comcast's NBCUniversal cuts streaming technology jobs
item.description: Comcast's NBCUniversal is cutting jobs in its global streaming technology organization, the owner of the Fast & Furious and Jurassic Park franchises said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Comcast's (CMCSA.O) NBCUniversal is cutting jobs in its global streaming technology organization, the owner of the Fast & Furious and Jurassic Park franchises said on Thursday. The number of employees affected would depend on the outcome of consultations with employees, a source familiar with the matter said. Most of the cuts are at Sky, Comcast's European media arm, although some US-based NBCUniversal employees will also be impacted, the source added. NBCUniversal said it is proposing changes to its Global Streaming Technology organization to ensure it has the right structure and resources in place for future growth. The layoffs come as media companies seek to improve margins in their streaming operations after years of heavy investment in technology and content.

item.title: Massachusetts man indicted for repeated calls, texts to Stephen Miller's wife
item.description: Federal prosecutors on Thursday charged a Massachusetts man with cyberstalking Katie Miller, the wife of White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller, accusing him of repeatedly calling and texting her and sending vulgar messages to her and her parents.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Federal prosecutors on Thursday charged a Massachusetts man with cyberstalking Katie Miller, the wife of White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller, accusing him of repeatedly calling and texting her and sending vulgar messages to her and her parents. Federal prosecutors in Boston secured an indictment charging John Anthony Proia III, 41, with cyberstalking a former political adviser and prominent figure in the Republican Party who is married to a high-level official. While the indictment did not identify the alleged victim by name, a person familiar with the matter confirmed she is Katie Miller, a conservative podcaster who is married to Stephen Miller, one of President Donald Trump's closest advisers. "This behavior is criminal and will be treated as it should - with prosecution!" US Attorney General Todd Blanche wrote in a social media post on X. Katie Miller reposted Blanche's message and thanked him. Proia, of Waltham, pleaded not guilty during an initial court hearing in Boston. His attorney did not respond to a request for comment. The investigation became public after two counterterrorism officials at the FBI's Washington Field Office were demoted and reassigned to lesser positions in the agency's Washington headquarters following issues related to the inquiry, sources familiar with the matter said. Prosecutors said that from August 3 to September 23, Proia used multiple phone numbers to contact his alleged victim, often using expletives and speaking in a "menacing tone." Prosecutors said he also sent text messages to phone numbers associated with Katie Miller's parents, including ones describing her husband as "evil" and a "Jewish Nazi/white supremacist." "As alleged in the Indictment, the defendant repeatedly and relentlessly targeted the victim, her husband and her family with deeply disturbing communications that profoundly disrupted their lives," US Attorney Leah Foley in Massachusetts said.

item.title: Parole granted to ex-officer convicted of Black man's 2018 murder in Dallas
item.description: Former Dallas police officer Amber Guyger was granted parole on Thursday after serving seven years of a 10-year prison sentence for the 2018 shooting death of a Black man while he was eating ice cream in his apartment, according to the Texas Board of Pardons and Parole.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: Former Dallas police officer Amber Guyger was granted parole on Thursday after serving seven years of a [USN:KBN1WG4E4 TEXT:"10-year prison sentence"] for the 2018 shooting death of a Black man while he was eating ice cream in his apartment, according to the Texas Board of Pardons and Parole. Guyger, who is white, was sentenced in 2019. A Texas jury found her guilty of murder for shooting her neighbor, Botham Jean, after she mistakenly walked into his apartment thinking it was her own. The incident sparked street protests over his killing and over the issue of police brutality in the US against individuals of color, particularly Black people. The Texas Board of Pardons and Parole, which is appointed by Governor Greg Abbott, a Republican, said Guyger's record did not include a documented pattern of violent or assaultive arrests or convictions, and indicated that she "maintained a satisfactory institutional adjustment." Lee Merritt, an attorney for Jean's family, said the family "strongly opposed" the parole. "Justice cannot be selective. When a life is taken without cause, accountability has to mean something, for everyone. Today's decision tells grieving families it can be cut short," Merritt said in a statement. The sentence for Guyger was less than the 28 years prosecutors had initially sought. Jean was eating ice cream in his living room when Guyger entered his apartment. Prosecutors argued that she did not do enough to help Jean because after shooting him and then realizing her mistake, she did not administer first aid, although she did call 911 for an ambulance. Prosecutors also showed the jury text messages that painted Guyger as racist. Guyger, who spent four years as a Dallas police officer before the killing, took the rare step of testifying in her own defense during her trial, expressing regret for shooting Jean but saying she believed her life was in danger when she pulled the trigger.

item.title: Lula leads Bolsonaro by 3 points in Brazil runoff scenario, Datafolha poll shows
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva leads Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, his main challenger, in a potential runoff ahead of this month's election, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva leads Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, his main challenger, in a potential runoff ahead of this month's election, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday. In a simulated runoff, Lula would receive 48% of the vote compared with 45% for Bolsonaro, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. A previous Datafolha poll had Lula leading Bolsonaro by 47% to 45%. The result still represents a technical tie as the poll's margin of error is 2 percentage points In a first-round scenario, Lula leads with 42% of the vote, followed by Bolsonaro (38%), Augusto Cury (4%), Ronaldo Caiado (3%) and Renan Santos (3%) The previous Datafolha poll showed the leftist president with 40% against the right-wing senator's 36% If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes in the first round on Sunday, the two frontrunners advance to a runoff set for October 25 Datafolha surveyed 2,506 people between September 29 and October 1

item.title: ウクライナ、国産戦術弾道ミサイル「ＦＰ７」初実戦使用＝大統領
item.description: [１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１日、国産の戦術弾道ミサイル「ＦＰ７」を初めて実戦で使用したと明らかにした。

通信アプリのテレグラムに「ウクライナの戦術弾道ミサイルＦＰ７。初の実戦使用だ」と投稿。「成果に感謝する。次は生産だ」と述べた。

使用した場所や標的は明らかにしなかった。

ロシアはウクライナの標的への攻撃で弾道ミサイルを頻繁に使用しており、ウクライナは独自の戦術弾道ミサイル開発を防衛上の重要な要素と位置付けてきた。

今冬にロシアによる継続的な攻撃が予想される中、ウクライナにとって弾道ミサイルを効果的に迎撃する必要性が一段と高まっている。ウクライナのミサイル生産はロシアに大きく後れを取っている。

ゼレンスキー氏は今年に入って戦術弾道ミサイルの試験結果を高く評価し、軍による運用に向けて有望な結果が示されたと述べていた。

ウクライナの軍事アナリストはＦＰ─７について、射程約２００キロの短距離ミサイルだとしている。

製造元のファイア・ポイントによると、同ミサイルは今年立ち上がった欧州のミサイル防衛計画「フレイヤ」の一環として、弾道ミサイル迎撃用に開発されている。

軍事アナリストはＦＰ７を米陸軍の戦術ミサイルシステム「ＡＴＡＣＭＳ（エイタクムス）」になぞらえている。ＡＴＡＣＭＳは既にウクライナに供与されているが、ロシアの脅威に対抗するために開発が加速されたＦＰ７はＡＴＡＣＭＳより大幅に安価だ。

ファイア・ポイントは最大射程８５０キロのミサイル「ＦＰ９」も開発しており、同社幹部によると年内に完成する見通し。

両ミサイルの配備により、ウクライナはロシアのミサイル発射拠点や生産施設を攻撃し、同国の戦争遂行を支えるインフラに圧力をかけることが可能になるとアナリストは指摘する。

ウクライナと西側の主要同盟国は７月、フレイヤ計画を推進するための防空連合の発足を発表した。同計画は、米国製の防空システム「パトリオット」に代わる、より安価なシステムを共同開発することを目指している。

item.title: OpenAI alerts more than 100 groups about rogue AI agent activity
item.description: OpenAI has informed more than 100 organizations about incidents involving unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents, according to a blog post by the ChatGPT maker, as AI labs face mounting scrutiny over rogue AI agent activity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: OpenAI has informed more than 100 organizations about incidents involving unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents, according to a blog post by the ChatGPT maker, as AI labs face mounting scrutiny over rogue AI agent activity. Here are some other details: The Sam Altman-led company has been conducting a broad review of the activities of its AI models after the accidental hacking of Hugging Face. OpenAI is searching through roughly 50 petabytes of data as it works to understand the full scope of its rogue agent activity. A string of high-profile breaches globally by rogue AI agents in recent months has sparked widespread worries within the AI industry over its ability to control the more powerful AI models now under development. "In some cases, models used internet access in unintended ways or, in retrospect, did not have the ideal restrictions applied. Over the last several months, we have been applying new technical and operational measures to avoid similar problems, or catch them very early, and will continue this work," OpenAI said. OpenAI previously said [USN:L1N45I00D TEXT:"the review would take months"] to complete given the scale of the work. The [USN:L6N4580VP TEXT:"Hugging Face incident"] remains the most severe rogue agent activity OpenAI has identified from its AI models so far.

item.title: 米ディズニー、テレビ事業再編計画 数百人削減も＝ＷＳＪ
item.description: [１日 ロイター] - 米メディア・娯楽大手ウォルト・ディズニーがテレビ事業の再編を計画しており、数百人規模の人員削減...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ディズニー、テレビ事業再編計画　数百人削減も＝ＷＳＪ 7:21 配信

写真はウォルト・ディズニーのロゴが表示されたスクリーン。2017年12月、ニューヨーク証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

[１日 ロイター] - 米メディア・娯楽大手ウォルト・ディズニーがテレビ事業の再編を計画しており、数百人規模の人員削減や部門統合につながる可能性があると、米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が１日、関係者の話として報じた。

メディア各社は、かつて高収益源だったケーブルテレビや放送ネットワーク事業が有料テレビの解約で縮小する中、コスト削減を進めている。動画配信事業は失われた利益を補うにはまだ至っていない。

ＷＳＪによると、計画はディズニー・エンターテインメント・テレビジョンのデブラ・オコネル会長が主導しており、年内にはまとまらない可能性がある。

ジョシュ・ダマロ氏が３月に最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に就任してから相次いでいる組織再編の一環という。

今回の再編は、数十年前に従来型のテレビ放送向けに構築されたブランド中心ではなく、動画配信サービスの利用者を軸に事業を組み直すことを目的としており、ＡＢＣエンターテインメント、２０世紀テレビジョン、Ｈｕｌｕオリジナルズ、フリーフォームなどの部門を率いる幹部に影響が及ぶ見通しだという。

ロイターは、ディズニーが昨年にも映画・テレビのマーケティング、テレビ広報、キャスティング・制作開発部門などで数百人を削減したと報じた。

今年もすでにマーケティング部門やピクサー、ＡＢＣニュース、ＥＳＰＮで人員を削減しており、９月２９日には主に人事・技術部門で数百人を削減したと、関係者がロイターに明らかにしていた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず アングル：米企業、金利上昇で借り換え負担増大　コロナ禍調達分の満期相次ぐ コラム：米利上げでアジア株式市場に明暗、経常赤字国の打撃大きく コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 最終更新: 10/2(金) 7:21 ロイター

item.title: ナイキ、追加人員削減含む新経営改善策 通期売上高1桁台後半の減少見通し
item.description:
Danielle Kaye Angela Christy M
[１日 ロイター] - 米スポーツ用品大手ナイキは１日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ナイキ、追加人員削減含む新経営改善策　通期売上高1桁台後半の減少見通し 7:19 配信

写真はニューヨークにあるナイキの店舗。2025年4月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper

Danielle Kaye　Angela Christy M

[１日 ロイター] - 米スポーツ用品大手ナイキは１日、追加の人員削減や世界事業の再編を含む新たな経営改善策を発表した。２０２７会計年度売上高が１桁台後半の減少率になるとの見通しも示し、エリオット・ヒル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の下で進める業績立て直しの取り組みを加速させる。

ナイキはヒル氏の就任後の約２年間、ランニングなど主要スポーツ分野への注力や、卸売業者との関係再構築を通じて成長回復を目指してきた。ただ今回示した業績予想は市場の想定に届かず、同社の苦境が今後少なくとも数四半期続く可能性を浮き彫りにした。特に中国事業の低迷が深刻で、第１・四半期の同事業売上高は為替変動の影響を除いたベースで前年同期比２６％減少した。ヒル氏による再建策の進展の遅さを巡る投資家の懸念が強まった形で、ナイキ株は時間外取引で一時４％下落した。

アナリストが業績悪化の大きな要因として挙げたのは、ナイキが消費者を引き付ける新商品を十分に投入できなかった点で、販売促進や値引きも増えている。

こうした中で事業運営体制を、これまでの世界４地域体制を「米州」「アジア太平洋・中華圏」「欧州・中東・アフリカ（ＥＭＥＡ）」の３地域に再編。インドには人材確保などの機能を備えた新たな拠点を開設する計画だ。

再編に伴う人員削減については、対象となる人数や職種は現時点で決まっておらず、従業員への通知は２７年に開始する。今回打ち出した措置は、既に発表している人員削減を含めた構造改革を拡大するもので、３１会計年度までに約２５億ドルのコスト削減効果を見込む。

かつてナイキの収益を支えた中国事業は、海外の競合企業や中国国内のスポーツ用品メーカーが存在感を高める中、低迷が続いている。中国はナイキの年間売上高の約１５％を占め、北米、欧州・中東・アフリカに次ぐ３番目に大きな市場だが、売上高は９四半期連続で減少した。

ナイキは最近、中国で一部の大手小売業者に認めているオンライン販売権を１月から取り消す方針を示した。価格設定や流通への統制を強め、販売回復につなげる狙いがある。

ただアナリストからは、こうした措置が過度な値引き販売の抑制にはつながるものの、中国の消費者にナイキ製品を再び選ばせることができるかを疑問視する声も出ている。ＢＮＰパリバのシニアアナリスト、ローラン・バシレスク氏は調査リポートで「ナイキが中国で抱えているのは販売チャネルの問題ではなく、商品の問題だ」と指摘した。

第１・四半期（６─８月）売上高は１１２億ドルとなり、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１１３億２０００万ドルを下回った。第１・四半期の粗利益率は４２．８％と、前年同期から０．６ポイント上昇。倉庫保管費や物流費の低下が寄与した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：年初来安値で確認する円の「現在地」、円安は欧州通貨高の裏返し＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 コラム：問われるベセント氏の信認、市場介入は小手先との批判も 最終更新: 10/2(金) 7:19 ロイター

item.title: US judge denies request to find Lindsay Clancy not guilty after mistrial
item.description: A Massachusetts judge who oversaw Lindsay Clancy's murder trial rejected a request on Thursday by her lawyers to declare her not guilty of murder, saying prosecutors presented sufficient evidence for a jury to find her responsible for killing her three young children in 2023.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A Massachusetts judge who oversaw Lindsay Clancy's murder trial rejected a request on Thursday by her lawyers to declare her not guilty of murder, saying prosecutors presented sufficient evidence for a jury to find her responsible for killing her three young children in 2023. Clancy's lawyers had urged Judge William Sullivan in Plymouth to conclude that prosecutors had failed to prove she could be held criminally responsible for her children's deaths despite suffering from what they said was mental illness. Sullivan declared a mistrial on September 4 after the jury deadlocked. No one at that trial disputed that Clancy strangled her three children with exercise bands on January 24, 2023, in the basement of their home in the Boston suburb of Duxbury. She then cut herself with a knife and jumped from a second-story window in an attempt to end her own life, leaving her paralyzed. But Clancy's lawyers contended at a post-trial hearing earlier this week that prosecutors had failed to present any evidence during the trial proving she had killed Cora, 5; Dawson, 3; and 8-month-old Callan. They also argued the evidence showed Clancy was in the throes of postpartum psychosis at the time and should be found not guilty by reason of insanity, known in Massachusetts as lack of criminal responsibility. Sullivan, though, said prosecutors had presented enough physical and circumstantial evidence to allow a jury to conclude that Clancy was the one who strangled the children and was criminally responsible for killing them. He cited testimony by the prosecution's expert witnesses who "testified that it was their opinion that the defendant did not lack substantial capacity to appreciate the criminality or wrongfulness of her conduct." "Although the defendant also produced expert witnesses who disagreed with the Commonwealth's experts, it is within the discretion of the fact finder to place little or no weight on that evidence," Sullivan wrote. Defense attorney Kevin Reddington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Plymouth County District Attorney Timothy Cruz's office has yet to lay out its plans for a potential retrial of the 36-year-old. Sullivan at a hearing on Tuesday stressed that he did not want the case to linger and told the parties to be ready to discuss a date for a retrial at a November 2 hearing. If convicted on first-degree murder charges, Clancy would face a sentence of life in prison. Several jurors [USN:L1N4510K5 TEXT:"in televised interviews"] after the initial trial said that but for the one holdout juror, they had been prepared to find Clancy not guilty by reason of insanity. If found not guilty on those grounds, she would be committed to a state psychiatric hospital for evaluation. Her commitment would then be subject to regular review by the court.

item.title: 米、イラン自動車・鉄道部門に制裁 海上封鎖下で圧力拡大
item.description:
Timothy Gardner
[ワシントン １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timothy Gardner

[ワシントン １日 ロイター] - 米財務省は１日、イランの鉄道・自動車部門と海外の供給業者に制裁を科したと発表した。戦時下でイランを孤立させるための経済圧力を拡大した。

今回の制裁は、同省が８月２４日に発表した「オペレーション・エコノミック・アウトキャスト（経済的追放作戦）」の一環で、イランの戦争、ミサイル製造、サイバー攻撃、イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）への資金源を断つことが狙い。

米国の経済圧力を海上から陸上に広げる措置で、海上封鎖によってホルムズ海峡経由の石油輸送を断たれたイラン政府が頼る部門を標的とする。ただ、制裁拡大はイランの一般市民に深刻な負担を強いる恐れがあるとアナリストは指摘する。

自動車大手のイラン・ホドロ（ＩＫＣＯ）とサイパ（ＳＡＩＰＡ）が制裁対象となった。財務省によると、両社はイラン国内の自動車市場の９０％超を占める。

同省はまた、旅客・貨物輸送を担う国営イラン・イスラム共和国鉄道なども制裁対象に指定した。

ベセント財務長官は、今回の措置について「イランを支える者を直接標的とし、米国とパートナー諸国がイラン政権の収入源を完全に断つための土台を築くものだ」と述べた。

制裁はイランの自動車産業に製品を供給するインドネシア、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）、トルコの企業も対象としている。

item.title: First Solar sues China's JA Solar for patent infringement
item.description: US solar panel maker First Solar sued China's JA Solar and a solar subsidiary of Corning on Thursday, expanding its patent enforcement campaign after announcing last month that it would shift its focus from a federal trade case to litigation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US solar panel maker First Solar (FSLR.O) sued China's JA Solar (002459.SZ) and a solar subsidiary of Corning (GLW.N) on Thursday, expanding its patent enforcement campaign after announcing last month that it would shift its focus from a federal trade case to litigation. First Solar accused JA Solar, along with Corning's American Panel Solutions, of infringing a US patent related to the manufacture of high-efficiency TOPCon solar cells, according to a complaint filed in US District Court in Delaware. The lawsuit alleges the defendants have manufactured, imported and sold solar cells and modules that use processes covered by the patent. JA Solar was the original developer of a solar panel factory in Arizona that Corning acquired in 2025. First Solar, which makes cadmium telluride thin-film solar panels, acquired the patents through its 2013 purchase of TetraSun. The patents cover TOPCon, or tunnel oxide passivated contact, a solar-cell technology that has become widely used by manufacturers of crystalline silicon solar panels. Last month, First Solar said it would [USN:L1N4580R3 TEXT:"withdraw"] a patent complaint pending before the US International Trade Commission and instead pursue infringement claims against rivals through federal litigation. The company has said it is also pursuing cases involving affiliates of Canadian Solar, Jinko Solar, T1 Energy and Trina Solar. Neither JA Solar nor Corning was immediately available for comment.

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（1日）利回り上昇一服、ユーロ下落 株上昇
item.description: ＜為替＞ ユーロ／ドルが１７カ月ぶり安値を付けた。世界的な債券売りで米欧の国債利回りが高水準に押し上げられる中、フランス...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（1日）利回り上昇一服、ユーロ下落　株上昇 7:02 配信

＜為替＞ ユーロ／ドルが１７カ月ぶり安値を付けた。世界的な債券売りで米欧の国債利回りが高水準に押し上げられる中、フランス国債利回りが１４年ぶり高水準を付けた。原油高もインフレ懸念を強めた。

ユーロ／ドルは１．１２１５ドルを下回り、２０２５年５月以来の安値を記録。終盤は０．７７％安の１．１２４３３ドルとなった。

ユーロは対円、対スイスフランでも下落。対ポンドでも辛うじてプラス圏を維持する水準にとどまった。

ドル指数 は０．５１％高で、２０２５年４月以来の高水準を付けた。

円は対ドルで０．４１％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．０７円だった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 朝方見られていた国債への売りが反転し、短期債から長期債まで幅広く利回りが低下した。米国債利回りはこれまで堅調な経済指標などを背景に大きく上昇。市場では世界的な債券売りは終了していないとの見方が出ているものの、利回り上昇がひとまず一服したことで安心感が広がった。

米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が朝方発表した９月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）で、堅調な需要を背景に投入価格が急騰し、インフレ圧力が続いていることが示されたことを受け、午前の取引で１０年債と３０年債の利回りが２００２年春以来の水準に上昇。原油高もインフレ高進につながるとの見方から、国債利回りの押し上げ要因になった。

ただ、米東部時間午前１０時（日本時間１日午後１１時）過ぎに流れが一転し、国債買いが優勢になった。市場関係者は、過去６週間にわたる利回りの急上昇で米国債のリスク・リターンが大きく改善したとの見方が広がったことで国債に対する買いが入ったとの見方を示している。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるハト派的な発言も利回り低下につながった。

終盤の取引で、金融政策見通しに敏感な２年債利回りは８．９４ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．７９８％。２年債利回りは、ジェファーソンＦＲＢ副議長の発言を受け下げ幅を拡大し、一時９月２２日以来の低水準を付けた。

１０年債利回りは５．０２ｂｐ低下の５．２４３％。一時５．３４４５％に上昇し、２００２年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 一時の下げから切り返し、上昇して引けた。世界的な債券売りに歯止めがかかり、米債利回りの上昇が一服したことが材料視された。

朝方発表された経済指標が引き続き景気の底堅さと根強い物価上昇圧力を示し、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が最終的により積極的な利上げを迫られるとの懸念が広がったことから、株価は一時、軟調に推移した。

米労働省が発表した週間の新規失業保険申請件数は前週比１０００件減の１９万７０００件と、約５７年ぶりの低水準に迫った。

米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が発表した９月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は前月からほぼ横ばいだったが、堅調な需要を背景に投入価格が急騰し、インフレ圧力が続いていることを示唆。これを受けて債券利回りが上昇幅を拡大し、株価を押し下げた。

半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは３％高。売上高見通しが市場予想を上回ったほか、長期供給契約に基づく顧客の資金拠出約束額が３２０億ドルに増加したことも明らかにし、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けメモリー半導体の需要が衰えていないことを示した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米国のインフレ率が予想を下回ったことを受け、１０月の米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による利上げ観測が後退し、金先物は小幅に上昇した。スポット金価格は米国東部夏時間午後２時０８分（日本時間午前３時０８分）時点で１オンス＝４１６５．２９ドルと０．２％高、１２月限の米国金先物は４２０２．３０ドルで０．４％高となった。金価格は９月に６％超下落していた。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 急伸。北海ブレント先物は４ドル超上昇した。米国が中東に部隊と空母を増派するとの報道や、中国製油各社による石油製品輸出停止を受け、世界的な燃料不足が深刻化するとの懸念が強まった。

清算値は、新たに期近となった北海ブレント先物１２月限が４．２８ドル（４．３７％）高の１バレル＝１０２．３１ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．４５ドル（２．７１％）高の９２．８７ドルだった。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: French supercomputer maker Bull doubles output to boost Europe's AI ambitions
item.description: Bull, the state-owned French maker of Europe's fastest supercomputers, reopened an expanded factory on Thursday to double its production capacity, executives told Reuters, as Europe bolsters its AI computing capacity.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: Bull, the state-owned French maker of Europe's fastest supercomputers, reopened an expanded factory on Thursday to double its production capacity, executives told Reuters, as Europe bolsters its AI computing capacity. The European Union has committed €7 billion ($7.87 billion) over 2021-2027 to a network of supercomputers, aiming to close a compute gap with the United States and China. Bull's plant in Angers, France, is the only factory in Europe dedicated to building these machines, and its expansion is meant to support that goal. Chief Executive Emmanuel Le Roux said Bull has received more orders this year than ever before, and has won 15 of the 18 tenders issued by EuroHPC, the EU body that co-funds Europe's network of supercomputers with member states, competing against companies including Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) . Airbus (AIR.PA) inaugurated Bull-built supercomputers in Toulouse and Hamburg this year, in a five-year deal worth close to €100 million that tripled the planemaker's simulation capacity. Cloud operator [USN:L6N42P11U TEXT:"OVHcloud"] (OVH.PA) and European Commission-backed [USN:L6N42X0XW TEXT:"Domyn"] are both attempting to train frontier-class AI models on Bull's JUPITER supercomputer alongside other companies Bull declined to name. OUTPUT COULD EXPAND AGAIN IN 2027 The Angers expansion cost €80 million, Bull executives said. Output has already doubled, from six racks a month previously to 12 now, and the plant can boost output to 24 next year on demand it expects to keep growing. France's order from Bull, a supercomputer named after computer scientist Alice Recoque, accounts for 94 racks, and is being assembled in parallel with [USN:L6N44S0D8 TEXT:"LUMI-AI"], Finland's €388 million system and Bull's biggest-ever contract. The two orders could not have been built alongside each other before the expansion, executives said. France completed its purchase of Bull from debt-laden IT group Atos (ATOS.PA) on March 31, valuing the company at up to €404 million. The original motive was strategic, Le Roux said. In the 1980s, after the United States stopped shipping supercomputers to the CEA, France's nuclear agency, France turned to Bull to build the machines that were used to simulate nuclear tests. Bull built JUPITER, Europe's first exascale machine, the fastest class of supercomputers, now running at the Juelich centre in Germany. Alice Recoque, ordered for the CEA, is due for delivery in stages from the end of this year, at a cost of €554 million to the French government and European Union. The Angers factory assembles systems using Nvidia (NVDA.O) , AMD (AMD.O) and Intel (INTC.O) processors, or European parts, depending on customer demands. European-made components account for 70% of the machines being built, up from 20% to 30% five years ago. Under a partnership signed in June, Bull and Taiwan's Foxconn <2317. TW> will also manufacture Nvidia's NVL systems at a plant in the Czech Republic, with final assembly in the Angers factory. ($1 = 0.8894 euros)

item.title: Commentary: What happens when Chinese AI goes rogue?
item.description: Using China as the boogeyman is no longer a convincing excuse for inaction on AI regulations by US lawmakers, says Catherine Thorbecke for Bloomberg Opinion.
item.dc:creator: Catherine Thorbecke
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Commentary

Commentary: What happens when Chinese AI goes rogue?

Using China as the boogeyman is no longer a convincing excuse for inaction on AI regulations by US lawmakers, says Catherine Thorbecke for Bloomberg Opinion.

Visitors walk past a display depicting artificial intelligence and a human hand at the China International Supply Chain Expo in Beijing on Monday, June 22, 2026. (Photo: AP/Ng Han Guan)

Catherine Thorbecke

Catherine Thorbecke

02 Oct 2026 05:58AM

Bookmark

FAST

TOKYO: Covering the recent round of AI apocalypse warnings, I’ve tried to reject this cult-like deference toward all-powerful computer systems and the inevitability rhetoric: If Silicon Valley doesn’t build them first, someone else – likely China – will.  Yet a recent spate of incidents in the United States has spurred a fresh, heated debate on the safety of allowing AI systems to act on their own. A growing number of researchers inside the companies involved are also warning of “existential” dangers, with Anthropic even flagging such concerns to investors in its initial public offering prospectus.  For China, the risks of near-term hazards like labour market threats or the more alarming sci-fi scenarios such as hacks on critical infrastructure are making it harder to write off the furore as a distinctly American obsession.  Beijing has dismissed some of these warnings as “fearmongering,” seeing the calls to slow AI development as an attempt to hold China back. But voices inside the industry have also suggested that frontier risks simply aren’t being felt as acutely at home because they’re further behind the US.

Huawei’s rotating Chairman Eric Xu wondered whether Chinese AI was advanced enough to encounter the “type of risk” US providers were increasingly debating.  AI model makers in China “may need to speed up their pace” to reach the level that they could “also feel the risks,” Xu said, according to Reuters, while acknowledging the need for balance. It shows how global debate has devolved in unhelpful ways. ONLY A MATTER OF TIME Accelerating the race is the wrong answer on both sides of the Pacific.  There are nearly 1,000 large language models in China, according to Bloomberg Intelligence. Competition on this scale already makes even Silicon Valley’s breakneck pace seem muted.  The Chinese industry has also been plowing significantly more resources into agents, or systems that can act more autonomously. Agent misbehaviour, especially the Hugging Face incident in July, when one of OpenAI’s agents broke out of its evaluation environment and broke into Hugging Face’s systems, has kicked off this recent safety reckoning.  As the short-lived OpenClaw frenzy showed, even China’s non-technical public is willing to experiment with them. It means if agentic AI is inherently more risky, it’s likely only a matter of time before we see concerning behaviour from Chinese AI tools.

Related:

Commentary: How would AI kill all humans? Here are the top 5 scenarios

Commentary: AI armageddon looks different from China

Companies are aware. A recent DeepSeek paper that includes founder and CEO Liang Wenfeng as a co-author bluntly warns that agent behaviour can be “untrustworthy”.  Escaping containment isn’t a distinctly American risk, either. Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3 exploited a loophole in a sandbox during cybersecurity testing, according to US-based Frontier Security. And some Chinese AI agents have also shown the kind of deceptive and concerning trends that have raised alarm about US tools. While Beijing has pushed back on some of the doomerism, policymakers are paying attention.  China in September released AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0, a policy document that notably also dropped in English, clearly aimed for Western audiences. It explicitly warns that AI has demonstrated a “self-accelerating trend,” and notes the question of whether this could exceed human control demands attention and vigilance.  Another cornerstone of the latest safety contention is recursive self-improvement (RSI), or AI systems that can autonomously advance their own capabilities. It’s the development path that spurred an Anthropic researcher to quit and warn that makers of the technology earnestly believe it could “kill us all” within a decade.  As Oxford China Policy Lab’s Zilan Qian has argued, China is further along in this regard than many in the West may realise, partly because its researchers describe it in different terms. It all reveals how little visibility each side has into the risks of what the other is building.

Related:

Commentary: Why do Trump and Xi keep meeting if the hard issues remain unresolved?

Commentary: An OpenAI agent hacked an Australian government health data portal. Will anyone be held responsible?

CHINA IS NOT AN EXCUSE FOR INACTION In discussing the technology’s risks, President Xi Jinping has warned – most recently in conversation with US President Donald Trump – that “AI must be kept under human control.”  Xi’s self-interest in maintaining order offers a narrowing window for cooperation on risk mitigation dialogue. It also exposes the limits of the safety protocols that did emerge from the Trump-Xi summit, namely a new “channel” for reporting AI-related incidents.  These hotlines haven’t always been effective. During the 2023 spy-balloon crisis, the Pentagon tried to reach its Chinese counterparts through a crisis line but Beijing declined the call. Such a setup is also inherently retroactive.  Preventative risk sharing also doesn’t have to depend solely on government-to-government talks, especially when regulators may struggle to keep pace with the technical knowledge. It would be more productive to have outlets where companies and researchers can exchange information more directly. China has burdensome regulations in place surrounding AI; using it as the boogeyman is no longer a convincing excuse for inaction from lawmakers in Washington.  If Chinese AI systems are just months behind, and the country’s all-out push for agents comes to fruition, it’s likely a matter of time before more concerning scenarios emerge from the other side of the Pacific. Policymakers should act before the next incident is more than just a warning shot.

Source: Bloomberg/ch
