item.title: Ducks D Tristan Luneau reportedly agrees to six-year, $43.2M deal
item.description: The Anaheim Ducks and defenseman Tristan Luneau have agreed to a six-year extension through the 2032-33 season, the club announced Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Anaheim Ducks and defenseman Tristan Luneau have agreed to a six-year extension through the 2032-33 season, the club announced Thursday. Published reports peg the deal at $43.2 million. Luneau, 22, received the lucrative pact despite having played in just 14 NHL games. He had two goals and two assists in brief stints over the past three seasons. He scored a goal in his lone game with Anaheim last season. "Signing Tristan to a long-term contract was a priority as we see him as a top-four defenseman for years to come," Ducks general manager Pat Verbeek said in a news release. "Getting the deal done before the season started was a key part of our planning for now and the future." A second-round pick by Anaheim in 2022, Luneau has stood out with AHL affiliate San Diego over the past two seasons. He had nine goals and 52 points in 59 games for San Diego during the 2024-25 season and had 10 goals and 41 points in 70 games last season. The 93 combined points were third-most among AHL defensemen over the past two seasons. --Field Level Media

item.title: Juiz nega pedido para que Lindsay Clancy seja considerada inocente após anulação de julgamento
item.description: Um juiz de Massachusetts que presidiu o julgamento de Lindsay Clancy por homicídio rejeitou, nesta quinta-feira, um pedido de seus advogados para que ela fosse declarada inocente do crime, afirmando que a promotoria apresentou provas suficientes para que o júri a considerasse responsável pela morte de seus três filhos pequenos em 2023.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Um juiz de Massachusetts que presidiu o julgamento de Lindsay Clancy por homicídio rejeitou, nesta quinta-feira, um pedido de seus advogados para que ela fosse declarada inocente do crime, afirmando que a promotoria apresentou provas suficientes para que o júri a considerasse responsável pela morte de seus três filhos pequenos em 2023. Os advogados de Clancy haviam instado o juiz William Sullivan, em Plymouth, a concluir que a promotoria não havia conseguido provar que ela pudesse ser considerada criminalmente responsável pela morte de seus filhos apesar de sofrer do que eles alegavam ser uma doença mental. Sullivan declarou a nulidade do julgamento em 4 de setembro, após o júri chegar a um impasse. Ninguém naquele julgamento contestou que Clancy estrangulou seus três filhos com faixas elásticas de ginástica em 24 de janeiro de 2023, no porão de sua casa em Duxbury, subúrbio de Boston. Em seguida, ela se cortou com uma faca e pulou de uma janela do segundo andar na tentativa de tirar a própria vida, ficando paralisada. Mas, nesta quinta-feira, os advogados de Clancy alegaram que os promotores não apresentaram nenhuma prova no julgamento que comprovasse que ela tivesse de fato matado Cora, de 5 anos; Dawson, de 3; e Callan, de 8 meses. Eles também argumentaram que as provas demonstravam que Clancy estava em meio a uma psicose pós-parto naquele momento e deveria ser considerada inocente por motivo de insanidade. Sullivan, porém, afirmou que a promotoria havia apresentado provas físicas e circunstanciais suficientes para permitir que o júri concluísse que Clancy foi quem estrangulou as crianças e era criminalmente responsável por matá-las. Ele citou o depoimento das testemunhas periciais da acusação, que “declararam ser de sua opinião que a ré não carecia de capacidade substancial para compreender a criminalidade ou a ilicitude de sua conduta”. “Embora a ré também tenha apresentado peritos que discordavam dos peritos da acusação, cabe ao julgador, a seu critério, atribuir pouco ou nenhum peso a essas provas”, escreveu Sullivan.

item.title: Saints place RB Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) on injured reserve
item.description: The New Orleans Saints placed running back Travis Etienne Jr. on injured reserve Thursday due to a hamstring injury.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New Orleans Saints placed running back Travis Etienne Jr. on injured reserve Thursday due to a hamstring injury. Etienne, who aggravated a hamstring injury Sunday in a 35-27 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders in the Saints' home opener, must miss at least four games. He leads the Saints with 30 carries and 128 rushing yards. He also has 11 receptions on 13 targets for 51 yards. Etienne signed with New Orleans in March to a reported four-year, $52 million deal after five seasons with Jacksonville. The Jaguars selected him in the first round (25th overall) of the 2021 NFL Draft out of Clemson, though he missed his entire rookie season due to injury. He rushed for 3,798 yards and 25 touchdowns and caught 168 passes for 1,338 yards and seven TDs in 66 regular-season games (60 starts) with Jacksonville. The Saints have 31-year-old running back Alvin Kamara, a five-time Pro Bowl selection (2017-21) who has rushed 18 times for 51 yards over two games this season. He missed time in September due to a knee injury. Kamara has 1,692 carries, 7,301 yards and 61 rushing touchdowns, as well as 612 catches for 4,960 yards and 25 TDs in 128 regular-season games (96 starts) with New Orleans since 2017. Kendre Miller (13 carries, 44 yards, one TD in two games) and rookie CJ Donaldson (four carries, 11 yards, in three games) are behind Etienne and Kamara on the depth chart. New Orleans (1-2) hosts the Atlanta Falcons (1-2) on Monday night. --Field Level Media

item.title: Discurso de Delcy Rodríguez en que critica a Trump en asamblea de la ONU es de 2019
item.description: Un discurso de 2019 en el que Delcy Rodríguez, entonces vicepresidenta de Venezuela y actual presidenta interina, criticó al presidente Donald Trump ante la Asamblea General de la ONU se comparte como un registro de su participación en la edición de 2026.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un discurso de 2019 en el que Delcy Rodríguez, entonces vicepresidenta de Venezuela y actual presidenta interina, criticó al presidente Donald Trump ante la Asamblea General de la ONU se comparte como un registro de su [USN:L6N45G15V TEXT:"participación"] en la edición de 2026. Publicaciones en Facebook difunden el video con fragmentos del discurso de Rodríguez en el que criticó a Trump, el [USN:L1N41M046 TEXT:"bloqueo"] estadounidense a Cuba y defendió al gobierno venezolano. Un ejemplo dice en una etiqueta: “Delcy Rodríguez le escupe la cara a Donald Trump desde Nueva York”. Sin embargo, el video es del 27 de septiembre de 2019 y no muestra un discurso reciente de Rodríguez. El video se publicó ese día en los canales de YouTube del Ministerio para Relaciones Exteriores y Comercio Internacional de Venezuela y en el de la ONU , con doblaje en inglés. Reuters también publicó ese día imágenes de la participación de Rodríguez con el mismo saco azul, blusa blanca y anteojos redondos. La presidenta interina venezolana [USN:S0N3ST09E TEXT:"dijo"] el 23 de septiembre de 2026 en la Asamblea General de la ONU que el país celebraría elecciones, sin especificar una fecha. Además, agradeció a Trump y su Gobierno por “su disposición a retomar el camino de las relaciones diplomáticas y de cooperación” con el país latinoamericano. Trump se [USN:L6N45E138 TEXT:"reunió"] el 22 de septiembre con Rodríguez y fue su primer encuentro desde que las fuerzas estadounidenses capturaran al entonces presidente Nicolás Maduro en una redada en enero. El gobierno de Venezuela no respondió inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios. VEREDICTO Falta contexto. El video es de un discurso de Rodríguez en la asamblea de la ONU en 2019, no 2026. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Alaska LNG could cost more than double Gulf Coast rivals, raising questions over economics
item.description: US President Donald Trump's push to steer $54 billion of South Korean investment into Alaska LNG is putting a fresh focus on a 20 million-ton-a-year export project that would cost more than twice as much as a comparable US Gulf Coast plant.
item.dc:creator: Curtis Williams
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump's push to steer $54 billion of South Korean investment into Alaska LNG is putting a fresh focus on a 20 million-ton-a-year export project that would cost more than twice as much as a comparable US Gulf Coast plant. Trump unveiled the plan on Wednesday as part of a broader [USN:L1N45M0IK TEXT:"$200 billion South Korean package"]. Seoul quickly said it had not yet decided whether to fund [USN:L4N45M0CI TEXT:"Alaska LNG"] and would first review the project's commercial viability. "The question is whether Asian buyers are willing to pay a premium in exchange for security of supply. So far, we have not seen evidence of that," said Jason Feer, head of business intelligence at Poten & Partners. Lead developer Glenfarne Group estimates Alaska LNG will cost $44.5 billion to $54.5 billion. That works out to roughly $2.2 billion to $2.7 billion per million metric tons per annum of capacity, by far the highest of any US export project ever proposed. By comparison, the wave of US LNG projects approved since Russia's invasion of Ukraine has generally been built at an average cost of about $1 billion per mtpa or less. Cheniere Energy's (LNG.N) Corpus Christi Stage 3 expansion was estimated to cost about $8 billion for 10.5 mtpa of additional capacity, or roughly $760 million per mtpa. Venture Global's (VG.N) Plaquemines LNG project represented approximately $21 billion of investment for 20 mtpa, while NextDecade's (NEXT.O) Rio Grande LNG and Woodside Energy's (WDS.AX) Louisiana LNG are also near the $1 billion-per-mtpa threshold. Gulf Coast export terminals tap extensive networks supplying shale gas from Texas, Louisiana and Appalachia. Alaska LNG would instead require an 800-mile (1,287-km) pipeline from the North Slope — a region in northern Alaska between the Brooks Range mountains and the Arctic Ocean — to Nikiski, estimated to cost $13.2 billion to $16.9 billion. In addition to the pipeline, the project requires a large treatment plant on the North Slope before gas can be moved south for export. Glenfarne's latest estimates place the cost of the treatment facility at $7.7 billion to $9.2 billion and the liquefaction terminal itself at $23.6 billion to $28.4 billion. Alex Munton, director of global gas and LNG research at Rapidan Energy Group, said the project "may not be able to meet commercial thresholds for investment." Glenfarne did not immediately respond to a request for comment. On Wednesday, CEO Brendan Duval said Trump's announcement would help bring "together the capital needed to accelerate Alaska LNG to a final investment decision and construction." Supporters say Alaska LNG's location offers a strategic advantage because cargoes would reach key Asian importers such as Japan, South Korea and Taiwan significantly faster than Gulf Coast shipments, lowering shipping costs. "Asia needs stable, secure supplies of gas and for that they may be willing to pay a premium," said Jack Weixel at East Daley Analytics. He noted, however, that Canadian [USN:L6N45L0EF TEXT:"projects"] in the region could have advantages over Alaska LNG. "These LNG developers should be looking at any and all options as the global market for natural gas, particularly among non-OECD nations, grows," he said. "But, some will work better than others."

item.title: Trump inicia en Texas y Oklahoma una campaña electoral complicada para los republicanos
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump viaja este jueves a Texas y Oklahoma para iniciar una intensa campaña de 32 días destinada a reforzar a los candidatos republicanos, mientras su partido lucha por mantener sus escasas mayorías en el Congreso en las elecciones legislativas de noviembre.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump viaja este jueves a Texas y Oklahoma para iniciar una intensa campaña de 32 días destinada a reforzar a los candidatos republicanos, mientras su partido lucha por mantener sus escasas mayorías en el Congreso en las elecciones legislativas de noviembre. Trump quiere ser la cara visible de la campaña del partido para las elecciones de mitad de mandato y tiene previsto hacer campaña en varias circunscripciones reñidas de la Cámara de Representantes y el Senado, en un momento en el que algunos candidatos republicanos no tienen claro si eso les ayudará o les perjudicará. Algunos candidatos se muestran cada vez más dispuestos a distanciarse de él en cuestiones que irritan a los votantes, como la guerra con Irán y la proliferación de centros de datos que consumen grandes cantidades de electricidad. Trump dijo el miércoles a seguidores en un acto en la Casa Blanca que, hasta la fecha, no había sabido vender bien su balance económico desde que regresó a la Casa Blanca en enero de 2025. El descontento de los votantes por su gestión de la economía ha provocado un cambio en el mapa electoral, y los analistas políticos consideran ahora que algunos escaños republicanos que antes se daban por seguros estarán en disputa en noviembre. "Voy a salir a la palestra porque nadie lo está vendiendo. Estamos haciendo un trabajo extremadamente malo en materia de promoción, y un trabajo extremadamente bueno a la hora de dirigir el país", dijo Trump. "Pero lo daremos a conocer. No debería ser difícil". Texas es una de las ocho contiendas por el Senado de Estados Unidos consideradas reñidas. Se espera que el candidato republicano Ken Paxton, fiscal general del estado, aparezca junto a Trump en un acto al norte de Dallas, según la oficina del candidato. Los observadores políticos estarán atentos a cualquier interacción incómoda entre ambos tras la filtración de una grabación en la que Paxton le decía a un grupo de donantes que la convención que encabezó Trump en septiembre, le perjudicó a él y a otros candidatos republicanos.

item.title: Venture Global asks federal regulators to place in service its Plaquemines LNG plant
item.description: Venture Global has asked federal regulators to allow it to place phase 1 of its Plaquemines LNG plant into service, a final step before it can begin commercial operations at the LNG export facility in Louisiana, according to a FERC filing on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Curtis Williams
item.content:encoded: Venture Global (VG.N) has asked federal regulators to allow it to place phase 1 of its Plaquemines LNG plant into service, a final step before it can begin commercial operations at the LNG export facility in Louisiana, according to a FERC filing on Thursday. Once approved, it will allow the company to sell LNG to its long-term customers that include Shell (SHEL.L) . "Given the success of these commissioning operations, Plaquemines LNG respectfully requests authorization to place all of Phase 1 in-service," the company wrote. Venture Global had previously said that despite high global LNG prices it will begin commercial operations on October 31. LNG prices have averaged in September above $25 per million British thermal units at both the European benchmark TTF and Asian benchmark JKM, according to financial firm LSEG. The company has benefited from high spot prices during Plaquemines' commissioning period. Plaquemines is the second-largest US LNG facility.

item.title: Spanish housing decree imperilled by opposition of Junts party
item.description: Chances that Spain's Congress would pass a decree aimed at curbing the housing crisis grew dimmer on Thursday after Catalan kingmaker party Junts raised last-minute issues and requested the government devise a new proposal on the eve of a scheduled vote.
item.dc:creator: David Latona
item.content:encoded: Chances that Spain's Congress would pass a decree aimed at curbing the housing crisis grew dimmer on Thursday after Catalan kingmaker party Junts raised last-minute issues and requested the government devise a new proposal on the eve of a scheduled vote. Junts, a separatist centre-right party with seven MPs, argued that the proposed measures would make matters worse by reducing housing supply. These include a ban on evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, a two-year rent freeze extension for existing leases, and tighter rules for short-term rentals. "Many of the measures included will produce the opposite effect of what is intended: they will reduce the supply of rental housing, drive up prices, and make it even harder for people with limited financial means to access housing," Junts said in a statement. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's minority leftist government has only 147 seats in the 350-seat chamber and relies on the support of a patchwork of smaller parties to pass legislation. Opposition parties have already signalled that they will not support the decree, one [USN:L1N45L0A6 TEXT:"of two"] crafted by Spain's Socialist government after [USN:L1N45K09H TEXT:"protests"] sparked by the [USN:L8N45F0PQ TEXT:"eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal"] last week. Thousands of mostly young activists camped out in Madrid's main square and other Spanish cities to protest the eviction and call for major reforms. A second decree, which would permit automatic and indefinite renewal of rental contracts, was already expected not to pass, failing to secure the minimum support required from Spain's fractured Congress. "I already thought the measures were insufficient and only temporary, but vetoing them is selfish and abandoning the people," Aidan, a 26-year-old wildfire firefighter, said of Junts' decision not to back the measures. "We'll keep up the encampment," he added.

item.title: プーチン氏、世界市場にディーゼル燃料供給せず 対ロ制裁解除まで
item.description: [モスクワ １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ １日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１日、対ロ制裁が解除されるまで、世界のエネルギー市場にディーゼル燃料を供給することはないと述べた。

プーチン氏は首都モスクワで開かれたロシア専門家らによる国際会議「バルダイ・フォーラム」の演説で、ロシアには十分なディーゼル燃料があるものの、「わが国の原油・石油製品に対する禁輸措置や制裁のため、世界市場には届かないだろう」と述べた。

ロシアは今週、燃料生産者に対するディーゼル輸出禁止措置を１０月末まで延長した。戦争や供給不足で既に動揺している世界のエネルギー市場に一段の圧力を加える格好となった。

プーチン氏はまた、ウクライナはロシアの石油精製所への攻撃により「目的を部分的に達成した」と述べ、ロシアの国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の１％に相当する損失をもたらしたと指摘。その上で、ロシアは現在、同様の手段で応酬していると述べた。

item.title: Reports: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo coming back for 11th season
item.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks are retaining manager Torey Lovullo for an 11th season, according to multiple reports on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Arizona Diamondbacks are retaining manager Torey Lovullo for an 11th season, according to multiple reports on Thursday. Lovullo, whose contract expired after this season, has agreed to a two-year deal, the Arizona Republic reported. The team has scheduled a news conference with Lovullo and general manager Mike Hazen for later Thursday. Hazen is under contract through 2028. The Diamondbacks finished 86-76 this season -- the best record for a non-playoff team -- to miss the postseason for the third consecutive year. They were eliminated on the final day of the regular season for the second time in three years. Lovullo also had to navigate around the distraction caused by three-time All-Star Ketel Marte not showing up for a game in Boston on Aug. 17. Marte later was placed on the 10-day injured list and returned to action on Aug. 31. Lovullo, 61, has a career mark of 750-768 (.494), making him the winningest manager in franchise history. He was National League Manager of the Year in his first season in 2017, when Arizona went 93-69, beat the Colorado Rockies in the wild-card game and fell 3-0 to the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL Division Series. The Diamondbacks made the franchise's second World Series appearance in 2023, falling short 4-1 to the Texas Rangers but building expectations. Instead, Arizona has missed the postseason as the Dodgers have won the NL West and captured the last two World Series championships. Lovullo is the third-longest tenured manager in the majors behind Tampa Bay Rays' Kevin Cash (12 seasons) and the Dodgers' Dave Roberts (11). --Field Level Media

item.title: US Navy awards RTX's Raytheon $24.4 billion contract for Standard Missile-6 amid stockpile concerns
item.description: RTX's Raytheon unit won a multiyear contract worth up to $24.4 billion to produce Standard Missile-6 interceptors for the US Navy, the service said on Thursday, as the Pentagon pushes to replenish munitions stockpiles depleted by conflicts in the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Mike Stone
item.content:encoded: RTX's Raytheon unit won a multiyear contract worth up to $24.4 billion to produce Standard Missile-6 interceptors for the US Navy, the service said on Thursday, as the Pentagon pushes to replenish munitions stockpiles depleted by conflicts in the Middle East . The five-year contract, which includes two additional option years, the Navy said, is meant to provide a steady and reliable supply of the SM-6, a missile that can carry out both offensive strikes and missile defense missions. The SM-6 award is the latest in a series of large munitions contracts the Pentagon has pursued this year to pressure contractors into ramping up output faster. It follows a $20.7 billion provisional multiyear deal for [USN:P8N3WG07W TEXT:"Raytheon's AMRAAM"] air-to-air missiles in late September and a $58.6 billion Patriot interceptor deal awarded to Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) in July. The production agreements are designed to entice contractors to. move faster on increasing output. They are part of a broader push by the Trump administration to prioritize weapons production over shareholder returns. Industry executives have warned that Congress has not yet appropriated funding for the deals, meaning contractors may be unable to invest at scale in components and facilities until lawmakers act. RTX (RTX.N) has said it has invested heavily to keep up with rising demand. It has expanded its skilled workforce, strengthened partnerships across the defense industrial base and automated production, with the aim of significantly increasing output for near- and long-term needs. Raytheon says the SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense. It has been fired from a range of Navy ships as well as from land-based launchers.

item.title: US law firm mergers dip through third quarter of 2026
item.description: Law firm mergers are slightly down so far in 2026 compared to last year, legal consultancy Fairfax Associates said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: Law firm mergers are slightly down so far in 2026 compared to last year, legal consultancy Fairfax Associates said on Thursday. There were 12 mergers completed in the third quarter and 58 total for the year, marking about a 5% decrease from the 61 mergers finalized by this point in 2025, according to Fairfax, which tracks deals by completion date. The [USN:L6N40Y0XH TEXT:"combination"] of international law firm Hogan Lovells and New York-based Cadwalader, which created 3,100-lawyer Hogan Lovells Cadwalader on July 1, was the largest deal of the quarter. Lisa Smith, a principal at Fairfax, told Reuters that a busy hiring market signals some firms may be choosing to expand through individual and group hires instead of mergers. Economic gaps between firms are growing, driven by differences in lawyers’ rates – which can make finding a firm that is a compatible merger partner more difficult, she said. Law firm mergers [USN:L6N3Y30GU TEXT:"increased"] 18% year-over-year in 2025, Fairfax said in January.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ／ドル17カ月ぶり安値、仏債利回りが急上昇
item.description: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン １日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロ／ドルが１７カ月ぶり安値を付...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ／ドル17カ月ぶり安値、仏債利回りが急上昇 6:08 配信

為替レートを表示するスクリーン。都内で5月撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　１日　ロイター］　 - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロ／ドルが１７カ月ぶり安値を付けた。世界的な債券売りで米欧の国債利回りが高水準に押し上げられる中、フランス国債利回りが１４年ぶり高水準を付けた。原油高もインフレ懸念を強めた。

ユーロ／ドルは１．１２１５ドルを下回り、２０２５年５月以来の安値を記録。終盤は０．７７％安の１．１２４３３ドルとなった。

ユーロは対円、対スイスフランでも下落。対ポンドでも辛うじてプラス圏を維持する水準にとどまった。

クラリティーＦＸのディレクター、アモ・サホタ氏は「直近の材料は最も厄介だ。欧州市場でパニックが起きている。フランスの債務水準が高すぎ、仏独の利回り格差拡大が市場に警戒感をもたらしている。これを受けてユーロは大きく値を下げ、下落ペースが再び加速した」と述べた。

ドル指数は０．５１％高で、２０２５年４月以来の高水準を付けた。

円は対ドルで０．４１％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．０７円だった。

ポンドは対ドルで０．４９％安の１．３２ドル。対ユーロでは横ばいで、ユーロは対ポンドで６月下旬以来の安値となる８５．１８ペンス近辺で推移した。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 158.07/158.08

始値 158.12

高値 158.24

安値 157.39

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1241/1.1243

始値 1.1293

安値 1.1216

item.title: ＦＲＢ当局者、10月利上げ観測払拭 データ重視の姿勢鮮明に
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者のうち２人が今...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ当局者、10月利上げ観測払拭　データ重視の姿勢鮮明に 6:03 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）ビル。2020年5月撮影。REUTERS/Kevin Lamarque

Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク　１日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者のうち２人が今週、金融政策の次の一手を決める前に、より多くのデータを見極める必要性があると主張したことを受け、市場では次回１０月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退した。

ニューヨーク連銀のウィリアムズ総裁は２９日、年内にあと１回の利上げが適切になる可能性があるとした上で、次回の利上げ時期を判断するために連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）には経済指標を見極める時間的余裕があると指摘。「ＦＲＢは９月のＦＯＭＣで政策措置を決定したため、（現在は）性急に行動する必要はない」と述べた。

ＦＲＢのジェファーソン副議長も１日、同様の見方を示した。同氏はバージニア大学ダーデン経営大学院での講演で、９月の会合で決定された利上げは支持するとしたものの、追加利上げを急ぐ必要はないとの考えを提示。「経済指標の動向、見通しの変化、リスクバランスを慎重に見極めた上で、今後の政策調整を決定していく必要がある」と述べた。

ウィリアムズ氏の発言を受け、市場ではＦＲＢが１０月２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで追加利上げに踏み切るとの観測は後退。ジェファーソン氏の発言は、その地合いの変化を確実なものとする一助となった。

世界の大手証券各社は現在、ＦＲＢの年内の追加利上げは１０月ではなく１２月の１回のみになると予想している。

＜「異例なほど明確な」ガイダンス＞

エバーコアＩＳＩのアナリストらは「ジェファーソン氏はウィリアムズ総裁のメッセージを確認した。つまり、ＦＲＢは１０月会合で連続利上げを行う予定はなく、経済情勢の推移を見極めるためさらに時間をかける方針だ」と指摘。「ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が金利の方向性についてほとんど、あるいは全くガイダンスを示していない状況下で、ジェファーソン、ウィリアムズ両氏のメッセージには重みがあると考える」と述べた。

ＳＧＨマクロの米国担当チーフエコノミスト、ティム・デュイ氏は顧客向けのリポートで「利上げに関する市場の織り込みがＦＲＢの想定から乖離（かいり）していたため、ウィリアムズ氏は異例なほど明確にならざるを得なかったと考える。これはＦＲＢのトップがフォワードガイダンスを示していないことの結果だ」と指摘した。

＜今後の利上げの可能性＞

他のＦＲＢ当局者も、金利変更前に一定の時間を置くべきだという見解に同調しており、中には、現在の金利政策では景気減速効果がほとんど、あるいは全く見られていないと懸念する当局者もいる。

ミネアポリス地区連銀のカシュカリ総裁は１日、９月のＦＯＭＣ以降に発表された経済指標に基づくと「米経済は自身の想定以上に好調だった」とし、「インフレ率は依然として高過ぎる」と指摘。「経済が極めて強靱で、インフレが自身の想定以上に根強いことが明らかになれば、政策金利を現在の想定を上回る水準に引き上げなくてはならない可能性がある」と語った。ただ、「実際にそうなるかは分からない」とも述べた。

３人の政策担当者はいずれも、インフレが時間とともに緩和すると予想しているが、そのペースについては慎重な見方を示している。

こうした中、ＦＲＢ当局者は２日発表の９月の米雇用統計に注目。足元の雇用関連データが労働市場の安定を示唆していることから、ＦＲＢ当局者は金利政策をインフレ抑制に集中させる余地があると述べている。そのため、今回の雇用統計が金利政策の見通しを再び書き換える可能性は低いとみられる。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米欧9月同時利上げ、浮き彫りになった「日銀の弱点」＝上野泰也氏 コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 10/2(金) 6:03 ロイター

item.title: Video de expresidente mexicano fuera de banco es de 2021, no de 2026
item.description: Un clip que muestra al expresidente mexicano Andrés Manuel López Obrador fuera de una sucursal del Banco del Bienestar fue publicado en septiembre de 2021 y no corresponde a un hecho reciente, como dicen publicaciones en línea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un clip que muestra al expresidente mexicano Andrés Manuel López Obrador fuera de una sucursal del Banco del Bienestar fue publicado en septiembre de 2021 y no corresponde a un hecho reciente, como dicen publicaciones en línea. Estos son los detalles clave: Publicaciones recientes en redes sociales identifican el video como una “reaparición” del exmandatario en Palenque, Chiapas. Sin embargo, el video fue publicado el 29 de septiembre de 2021 en TikTok por Diario Basta!, que no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. La descripción dice que corresponde a la inauguración de una sucursal del Banco del Bienestar en la alcaldía Gustavo A. Madero de la Ciudad de México. Una transmisión oficial del evento ese día muestra al mandatario con la misma ropa y las mismas personas del fondo del video compartido en línea. Imágenes publicadas por medios muestran otras perspectivas de la inauguración. Una comparación entre el video e imágenes de Google Street View de la Ciudad de México muestra elementos similares. El 30 de septiembre , López Obrador anunció en un video la publicación de su más reciente libro, y dijo que estaba en Chiapas. Veredicto: Erróneamente etiquetado. El video fue publicado en septiembre de 2021 y grabado en la Ciudad de México. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Trading Day: Stocks find footing as Treasury yields ease
item.description: Wall Street embarked on a new quarter with a nominally higher close on Thursday as the benchmark US Treasury yield eased back from multi-year highs after seven straight days of gains.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp
item.content:encoded: Wall Street embarked on a new quarter with a nominally higher close on Thursday as the benchmark US Treasury yield eased back from multi-year highs after seven straight days of gains. After a raft of generally upbeat economic data, focus turns to Friday's employment report, which is expected to show the US economy added 90,000 jobs in September, with the jobless rate holding firm at 4.1%. I will go into more detail on today's market moves below. If you have more time to read, here are a few articles I recommend to help you make sense of what happened in markets today. [USN:L1N45N05N TEXT:"The global bond selloff has sent borrowing costs surging to levels not seen in decades"] [USN:L8N45N14Y TEXT:"Even so, global bond markets are functioning as they should, according to the IMF"] [USN:S0N44H001 TEXT:"US factory activity expansion steady as input prices jump"] [USN:L1N45M123 TEXT:"US labor market is firming, as dip in jobless claims points to low layoffs"] [USN:L8N45M1N4 TEXT:"Iran is planning a forceful response if US attacks resume, while negotiations continue"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: [USN:L4N45N0KO TEXT:"Wall Street"] reversed an earlier selloff to close higher as bond yields eased, while [USN:L6N45N0DC TEXT:"European stocks"] closed at three-month lows SECTORS/SHARES: Energy, chips, software & services and Dow Transports were outperformers on the day, while healthcare and communication services were the clear laggards. Micron and Accenture both jumped after the companies provided better-than-expected revenue forecasts FX: The [USN:L1N45N00X TEXT:"dollar hit a 17-month high"] against the euro amid rising bond yields and oil prices BONDS: The benchmark US Treasury yield pulled back from a 24-year high as buyers stepped in, snapping a seven-session streak of gains COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L1N45N00Y TEXT:"Crude prices"] settled higher after China halted oil products exports; [USN:L4N45N00H TEXT:"gold"] gained on dampening Fed rate hike bets Today's Talking Points * Nvidia's enormous financing plan raises questions AI chipmaker [USN:L1N45L0J4 TEXT:"Nvidia's financing plan has raised questions"] on Wall Street over how much the company's advanced chips and the infrastructure surrounding them are worth. Some lenders want higher guarantees than the company had originally outlined as they try to assess how long the revenue from its chips will last, banking sources and credit managers told Reuters. The mismatch between Nvidia and Wall Street raises potential future financing headaches for AI companies seeking to tap deep new pools of capital. * Russia sends nuclear warning to NATO Russia has warned NATO that it would be ready to [USN:L1N45M09W TEXT:"resort to nuclear weapons"] in retaliation for any attempt to cut off Kaliningrad, a Russian exclave on the Baltic Sea, accusing the Western alliance of a "dangerous and reckless course" in the document viewed by Reuters. "Russia will be ready to use the entire arsenal of forces and capabilities at its disposal, including nuclear weapons, in order to defend its territory should NATO countries undertake any attempt aimed at isolating the Kaliningrad Region from the rest of the country," the note said. * Hackers impersonated an ex-US official to steal emails from AI experts Hackers — dubbed "TA419" by cybersecurity firm Proofpoint — have been impersonating US AI experts, including a former government official, in attempts to [USN:L6N45M1BB TEXT:"steal emails from experts at AI think tanks"], universities and other organizations. In a report, Proofpoint said that it had watched the hackers regularly try to steal passwords since as far back as 2025, and attributed the campaign to the TA419 based on the malware used, the internet infrastructure used to carry out the attacks, and the targets the group was focusing on. What could move markets tomorrow? Developments in the Middle East Energy market moves Bond yields Social media posts from Trump US employment (September) US factory orders (August) EU CPI (September) Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? item.title: Joy for Germany as Ronaldo-less Portugal win in Denmark
item.description: Germany claimed a first win under new coach Juergen Klopp on Thursday with a 2-0 Nations League victory over Serbia, while Portugal shrugged off the absence of Cristiano Ronaldo in Denmark and the Netherlands came from two goals down to draw 2-2 with Greece.
item.dc:creator: Nick Said
item.content:encoded: Germany claimed a first win under new coach Juergen Klopp on Thursday with a 2-0 Nations League victory over Serbia, while Portugal shrugged off the absence of Cristiano Ronaldo in Denmark and the Netherlands came from two goals down to draw 2-2 with Greece. Klopp selected a completely new starting XI from the side that lost to Greece last time out, handing debuts to goalkeeper Jonas Urbig and winger Derry Scherhant. Germany attacked the Serbia goal in waves but it took until the 39th minute to take the lead as Florian Wirtz picked out Tom Bischof to score his first senior national team goal in his second cap. After Nick Woltemade missed a sitter at the back post, Wirtz scored the second just past the hour-mark with a neat finish from the edge of the box. There will be relief for Klopp to get a win at the third attempt on his return to coaching, and his side were full value for their victory. "We played great against the ball and played wonderful football with the ball. I am really happy. This performance must now be the baseline," he said. Greece were close to making it three wins from three but conceded a late equaliser at home to the Netherlands. Fotis Ioannidis and Georgios Masouras scored first-half goals for the home side, before Virgil van Dijk halved the deficit just before the hour-mark. The visitors kept pushing for the goal and it arrived a minute from the end via Tijjani Reijnders. FOUR-STAR PORTUGAL Portugal, playing their first game since [USN:L6N45M17Z TEXT:"Ronaldo walked out on the squad"], putting his international future into doubt, were made to work for their 4-2 win in Denmark as they top A4 with a perfect nine points from their three games. The visitors scored twice in the first half through Joao Cancelo and Goncalo Ramos, but on each occasion the Danes found an equaliser as Mikkel Damsgaard and Rasmus Hojlund netted for the hosts. But Portugal would not be denied and Vitinha grabbed a 67th-minute goal and Joao Felix a late fourth to give Jorge Jesus’ side a six-point lead in the table after what has been a difficult few days. Dan James and Neco Williams scored for Wales as they beat 10-man Norway 2-1 to earn their first points of the campaign. In League B, the clash between Ireland and Austria in Dublin was stopped briefly when tennis balls were [USN:L8N45N0QU TEXT:"thrown onto the pitch"] in protest at the Irish side playing Israel in their previous fixture. Play soon resumed and Ireland were held to a 2-2 draw as a pair of goals from Troy Parrott was not enough for the win. Ireland's next game is a 'home' clash against Israel that will be played behind closed doors in neutral Serbia.

item.title: 米、中東に空母打撃群を追加派遣へ 対イラン攻撃再開を検討＝報道
item.description: [１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１日 ロイター] - 米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は１日、米政府当局者の話として、米国は３隻目の空母打撃群と海兵隊の艦艇を中東に追加派遣すると報じた。トランプ米大統領が中間選挙後のイラン攻撃再開を検討しており、中東地域に投入される兵員は９０００─１万人増えるという。

報道によると、艦艇や戦闘機、兵員らは１１月末までに現地に到着する。トランプ氏は最近、１１月中にイランへの空爆を再開する見通しだと側近らに伝えたという。

空母セオドア・ルーズベルトは９月２７日、予定されていた任務に向け、母港のサンディエゴを出港した。第１３海兵遠征部隊の隊員を乗せた水陸両用艦３隻で構成するマキン・アイランド水陸両用即応群は、２８日に出港した。

既に中東には空母ジョージ・Ｈ・Ｗ・ブッシュとジョージ・ワシントンの２隻が展開中。ワシントンがルーズベルト到着後も残留すれば、地域に展開する空母打撃群は４月以来初めて３個となる。

中東にはブッシュとワシントンに加え、ボクサー水陸両用即応群の艦艇も展開している。当局者の１人によると、今週出発した艦艇に乗る追加の兵員は、既に地域に展開している５万人超の兵員に上乗せされる。

ワシントンが地域を離れて日本の母港に帰還し、空母が再び２隻態勢に戻る可能性もある。

ホワイトハウスと国防総省の報道官はコメント要請に応じなかったという。

item.title: Trump administration claims racial bias at UCLA in law school crackdown
item.description: The US Department of Justice on Thursday said the University of California at Los Angeles discriminated against Asian and white applicants to its law school by consistently admitting Black and Hispanic students with lower Law School Admission Test scores.
item.dc:creator: Karen Sloan
item.content:encoded: The US Department of Justice on Thursday said the University of California at Los Angeles discriminated against Asian and white applicants to its law school by consistently admitting Black and Hispanic students with lower Law School Admission Test scores. The law school is the third named in a Justice Department probe after it made [USN:L1N4431OI TEXT:"similar allegations"] against Duke University’s law school in August and the [USN:L1N45113C TEXT:"University of California, Berkeley School of Law"] last month. The UCLA School of Law in a statement said it complies with state and federal law and its students are “admitted through a comprehensive, merit-based review process that considers each applicant’s achievements and experiences.” The investigations are part of a wider Trump administration [USN:L3N3OP05M TEXT:"crackdown"] on university diversity initiatives . Trump, who casts diversity goals as anti-merit and discriminatory against white people and men, has signed orders to dismantle them. Rights advocates say diversity practices address historic inequities for marginalized groups. Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon wrote in a Thursday letter to an attorney for UCLA that the law school had discriminated deliberately, saying the Justice Department is seeking a voluntary resolution to bring its admissions policies into compliance. “Like many of its peer institutions, UCLA Law School runs a two-tiered admissions system whose academic bar for acceptance shifts up or down depending on the color of your skin,” Dhillon said in a statement. The Justice Department said the law school’s applicant data between 2019 and 2025 showed it did not change its admissions practices after the US Supreme Court in 2023 barred the consideration of race in college admissions. In 2025, Black applicants had seven times the odds of being admitted compared to “otherwise equivalent” white applicants, the letter said. Hispanic applicants had two times the odds of getting in that year, the Justice Department said. Read more: [USN:L1N4431OI TEXT:"US scrutinizes more schools over admissions practices, diversity and pro-Palestinian protests"] [USN:L1N45113C TEXT:"Trump administration alleges UC Berkeley School of Law favors Black applicants in admission"]

item.title: Peso mexicano cae a mínimos desde noviembre de 2025 por aversión al riesgo, bolsa retrocede
item.description: El peso mexicano se hundió el jueves a niveles no vistos desde el año pasado, por un avance global del dólar y un repunte de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, debido a persistentes preocupaciones sobre el impacto inflacionario de la guerra en Medio Oriente.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano se hundió el jueves a niveles no vistos desde el año pasado, por un [USN:L1N45N0SA TEXT:"avance global del dólar"] y un repunte de los rendimientos de los [USN:L1N45N0ZY TEXT:"bonos del Tesoro"], debido a persistentes preocupaciones sobre el impacto inflacionario de la guerra en Medio Oriente. La atención del mercado se desplaza ahora hacia un esperado informe de la nómina no agrícola de Estados Unidos previsto para el viernes, luego de la divulgación esta semana de cifras del [USN:L6N45M0UX TEXT:"PIB"] y la [USN:L6N45M0TZ TEXT:"inflación"], en busca de señales adicionales sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés. * La moneda local cotizaba en 18.2920 unidades en la recta final de los negocios, con una depreciación de un 1.3%, a medida que el [USN:L1N45N0SA TEXT:"dólar estadounidense"] alcanzó un máximo de 17 meses y los retornos de los [USN:L1N45N0ZY TEXT:"bonos del Tesoro"] tocaron un pico de décadas antes de descender. * "La cotización de la divisa se vio impactada por un entorno internacional dominado por la aversión al riesgo", destacó Felipe Mendoza, analista de mercados de la firma EBC Financial Group. * En medio de la volatilidad, la moneda llegó a negociarse durante el día en 18.4330 unidades, su nivel más débil frente al dólar desde noviembre de 2025, extendiendo un deterioro que se ha profundizado durante las últimas semanas. * A inicios del mes pasado, el peso operaba sostenidamente por debajo de la barrera de 17 unidades, pero un giro restrictivo de la [USN:L1N4580OQ TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] despertó temores de que disminuya el diferencial de tasas con México, que durante años ha apuntalado a la divisa y los activos locales. * A mediados de septiembre, la Fed elevó las tasas de interés por primera vez desde 2023 y anticipó nuevos ajustes. En contraste, [USN:L6N45G177 TEXT:"Banco de México"] mantuvo sin cambios su tasa clave y señaló que no respondería mecánicamente a las decisiones de su par estadounidense. * Analistas han dicho que el diferencial de tasas entre México y Estados Unidos [USN:L1N45L0OH TEXT:"aún resulta atractivo"] y podría seguir sosteniendo las operaciones de [USN:L1N45M0I1 TEXT:"carry trade"], a pesar de la incertidumbre. * "Para la sesión de mañana viernes, el tipo de cambio estará determinado casi en su totalidad por la reacción del mercado al informe de las nóminas no agrícolas", dijo Mendoza. "Bajo este contexto, espero un rango operativo volátil entre los 18.22 y 18.52 pesos por dólar", afirmó. * El referencial índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) cayó un 0.60% a 63,828.60 puntos. * Los títulos del grupo aeroportuario GAP (GAPB.MX) encabezaron las bajas, con un 3.39% menos a 359.15 pesos, seguidos por los de la embotelladora y minorista FEMSA (FEMSAUBD.MX) , que restaron un 1.75% a 210.23 pesos. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años descendió nueve puntos básicos a un 9.54%, mientras que la tasa a 20 años bajó siete, a un 10.02%.

item.title: GM mantém liderança em vendas nos EUA, mas Toyota se aproxima
item.description: A General Motors manteve-se como a maior montadora dos Estados Unidos no terceiro trimestre, apesar de sofrer queda nas vendas, mas a Toyota Motor continuou a diminuir a distância, com consumidores optando por veículos híbridos.
item.dc:creator: Nathan Gomes, Kalea Hall
item.content:encoded: A General Motors (GM.N) manteve-se como a maior montadora dos Estados Unidos no terceiro trimestre, apesar de sofrer queda nas vendas, mas a Toyota Motor (7203.T) continuou a diminuir a distância, com consumidores optando por veículos híbridos. GM, Ford Motor e Stellantis, também conhecidas como as “Três de Detroit”, podem ver sua participação de mercado combinada cair para cerca de 36% no trimestre, de acordo com a empresa de pesquisa do setor Cox Automotive, enquanto marcas asiáticas com forte presença no segmento de híbridos, incluindo Toyota e Honda, devem responder por mais da metade das vendas de veículos novos no período. Os híbridos surgiram como a principal escolha dos consumidores à medida que a guerra no Irã faz os preços do petróleo e dos combustíveis dispararem. Os preços da gasolina comum atingiram uma média nos EUA de US$4,43 por galão em setembro em comparação com US$3,20 no ano anterior. Analistas esperam que a Toyota, com modelos como o popular Corolla híbrido, seja a que mais se beneficie dessa mudança. Embora as vendas gerais da Toyota tenham aumentado ligeiramente para 633.223 unidades no terceiro trimestre, as vendas do Corolla híbrido saltaram quase 36% em relação ao ano anterior, para 13.003 unidades. A Cox também espera que o Hyundai Motor Group supere a Ford (F.N) em vendas trimestrais nos EUA pela primeira vez, prevendo vendas de 511.421 veículos para a Hyundai no terceiro trimestre, em comparação com 504.172 para a Ford. A Ford deve divulgar vendas trimestrais na sexta-feira. Os modelos acessíveis da GM, incluindo o crossover Trax, ajudaram a montadora de Detroit a amenizar o impacto, mas as vendas gerais durante o terceiro trimestre caíram 5,5%, para 670.974 unidades. As vendas da Stellantis (STLAM.MI) no terceiro trimestre permaneceram praticamente estáveis em 324.277 unidades em relação ao ano anterior. A Cox estima que as vendas gerais nos EUA no terceiro trimestre tenham ficado em cerca de 4,1 milhões de veículos, uma queda de aproximadamente 1% em relação ao ano anterior.

item.title: ConocoPhillips signs 20-year LNG deal with Venture Global
item.description: Venture Global and ConocoPhillips said on Thursday they had signed a 20-year liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply agreement under which ConocoPhillips will buy 1 million tonnes a year of LNG starting in 2030.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Venture Global (VG.N) and ConocoPhillips (COP.N) said on Thursday they had signed a 20-year liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply agreement under which ConocoPhillips will buy 1 million tonnes a year of LNG starting in 2030. The deal comes as ConocoPhillips looks to bolster its LNG portfolio while challenges stemming from the Iran conflict have affected QatarEnergy's LNG operations and expansion projects in which ConocoPhillips holds interests. Here are more details: Under the agreement, ConocoPhillips will purchase 1.0 million tonnes a year of LNG from Venture Global for 20 years, with deliveries beginning in 2030. Venture Global said the agreement will support ConocoPhillips' growing global LNG portfolio. ConocoPhillips holds a 30% interest in QatarEnergy's Ras Laffan LNG project and also has stakes in LNG expansion projects in Qatar. Venture Global said it has more than 100 MTPA of LNG capacity in production, construction or development. The company's first three LNG projects, Calcasieu Pass, Plaquemines LNG and CP2 LNG, are located in Louisiana.

item.title: Petróleo sobe 4% com envio de mais tropas dos EUA ao Oriente Médio
item.description: Os preços do petróleo dispararam nesta quinta-feira e fecharam com alta de mais de US$4 por barril, depois que uma reportagem informou que os Estados Unidos estavam enviando mais tropas e porta-aviões para o Oriente Médio e que a China suspendeu as exportações de derivados de petróleo, alimentando temores de que a escassez global de combustível pudesse se agravar.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo dispararam nesta quinta-feira e fecharam com alta de mais de US$4 por barril, depois que uma reportagem informou que os Estados Unidos estavam enviando mais tropas e porta-aviões para o Oriente Médio e que a China suspendeu as exportações de derivados de petróleo, alimentando temores de que a escassez global de combustível pudesse se agravar. O novo contrato futuro do petróleo Brent com vencimento em dezembro fechou a US$102,31 por barril, alta de 4,37% ou US$4,28. Os futuros do petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fecharam a US$92,87 por barril, alta de 2,71% ou US$2,45. Uma reportagem do Wall Street Journal informou que os EUA estavam enviando um terceiro porta-aviões e até 10.000 soldados adicionais para o Oriente Médio, enquanto o presidente norte-americano Donald Trump avaliava a retomada dos ataques ao Irã após as eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA. Trump disse a repórteres na Casa Branca, antes de partir para uma viagem de campanha, que estava avaliando suas opções em relação ao Irã. “Agora tenho que tomar uma decisão. Ou eles assinam um acordo muito justo, ou deixarão de existir”, disse ele. Esses comentários, somados à suspensão das exportações de combustível pela China, contribuíram para um pregão volátil. Os preços do petróleo caíram 1% no início, mas reverteram a tendência depois que a Reuters noticiou que as refinarias chinesas haviam suspendido as exportações de derivados de petróleo para destinos além de Hong Kong e Macau até segunda ordem, citando quatro pessoas a par do assunto. “A proibição chinesa às exportações sugere preocupações com a disponibilidade de produtos no mercado interno”, disse o analista do UBS Giovanni Staunovo, acrescentando que ainda não se sabe se as medidas apoiarão um aumento nas importações de petróleo após as recentes reduções nos estoques chineses de petróleo e combustíveis. Embora os suprimentos de petróleo continuem chegando ao mercado, o diesel e outros produtos refinados permanecem em escassez devido aos danos à infraestrutura das refinarias no Golfo Pérsico e na Rússia. Os estoques globais de diesel já estão escassos depois que a Rússia, um dos principais exportadores do combustível, proibiu as exportações até outubro. Participantes do setor afirmaram que é improvável que a escassez termine antes do próximo ano. O presidente Vladimir Putin afirmou que a Rússia não fornecerá diesel aos mercados globais de energia até que as sanções contra Moscou sejam suspensas. “O impacto das restrições à exportação de combustíveis pela China não será tão grande quanto a perda das exportações de produtos petrolíferos refinados da Rússia e do Oriente Médio. No entanto, trata-se de mais uma fonte de pressão sobre os mercados globais de combustíveis, em um momento em que a oferta está severamente restrita”, disse Hamad Hussain, economista sênior especializado em clima e commodities da Capital Economics. Para amenizar a pressão, a força-tarefa de energia da União Europeia se reunirá na sexta-feira para discutir uma possível liberação dos estoques de diesel, disseram dois diplomatas da UE à Reuters nesta quinta-feira. Fontes informaram à Reuters que o governo Trump instruiu a Alemanha e a França a utilizarem seus estoques de emergência de diesel ou a enfrentarem uma possível proibição de exportação de diesel pelos EUA.

item.title: Recaudación de impuestos de Argentina aumenta 38,3% interanual en septiembre
item.description: La recaudación tributaria de Argentina subió un 38,3% en septiembre frente al mismo mes del año pasado, al sumar 12,36 billones de pesos (14.061 millones de dólares), informó el jueves la Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (ARCA).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La recaudación tributaria de Argentina subió un 38,3% en septiembre frente al mismo mes del año pasado, al sumar 12,36 billones de pesos (14.061 millones de dólares), informó el jueves la Agencia de Recaudación y Control Aduanero (ARCA). Este aumento se compara con una inflación acumulada del 33% en los últimos 12 meses. El presidente ultraliberal argentino, Javier Milei, impulsa drásticos cambios en la economía del país austral, que implican apertura económica y equilibrio fiscal para reducir la inflación. - Tipo de cambio: 1 dólar = 1.519 pesos

item.title: Fed's Cook sees AI inflationary push as a top 2027 risk
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said on Thursday that she sees AI, and its inflationary push, as a top risk for 2027, and noted that increasingly frequent supply shocks have had surprisingly persistent effects and become more salient for policy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said on Thursday that she sees AI, and its inflationary push, as a top risk for 2027, and noted that increasingly frequent supply shocks have had surprisingly persistent effects and become more salient for policy. "The AI build out is potentially creating inflationary pressures that may not resolve very quickly," Cook told New York Fed President John Williams at an event at the regional Fed bank. "So I think this is one of the main things that concerns me right now for 2027." Cook joined a unanimous vote last month at the Fed to raise the policy rate by a quarter of a point to support a "timelier" return of inflation to the Fed's 2% goal. Inflation by the Fed's targeted measure was 3.4% in August and has been above the goal for more than 5-1/2 years. Cook, voicing a view shared by many at the Fed, said she believes that in the longer term AI will boost productivity. But, she said, "I worry about when the productivity gains that would produce disinflation will come, and where the supply bottlenecks are going to be next." Geopolitical considerations, including the conflict in the Middle East, could also crimp supply chains. "Our conventional view used to be that we would look through the supply shocks because tighter monetary policy is not going to have an effect on oil prices, not going to have an effect on a war, but it could slow down employment and output outcomes that we would be more concerned about," Cook said. Now, however, it is possible that the "optimal response" could be different, depending for instance on the sectors affected by the supply shocks, she said.

item.title: プーチン氏、米中ロ3者会談に前向き 議題調整必要とも
item.description: [モスクワ １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ １日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１日、中国の習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領との３カ国首脳会談を行う用意があると述べつつも、まず議題を詰める必要があるとの認識を示した。

ロシア大統領府（クレムリン）は９月初旬、プーチン大統領、トランプ大統領、習近平国家主席が、１１月に中国で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせ３者会談を行う可能性があるとしていた。

item.title: 米国株式市場＝上昇、米債利回り上昇一服で
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は一時の下げから切り返し、上昇して引けた。世界的な債券売りに歯止めがか...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝上昇、米債利回り上昇一服で 5:22 配信

9月29日、ニューヨーク証券取引所の取引フロアで撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

［ニューヨーク　１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は一時の下げから切り返し、上昇して引けた。世界的な債券売りに歯止めがかかり、米債利回りの上昇が一服したことが材料視された。

朝方発表された経済指標が引き続き景気の底堅さと根強い物価上昇圧力を示し、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が最終的により積極的な利上げを迫られるとの懸念が広がったことから、株価は一時、軟調に推移した。

米労働省が発表した週間の新規失業保険申請件数は前週比１０００件減の１９万７０００件と、約５７年ぶりの低水準に迫った。

米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が発表した９月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は前月からほぼ横ばいだったが、堅調な需要を背景に投入価格が急騰し、インフレ圧力が続いていることを示唆。これを受けて債券利回りが上昇幅を拡大し、株価を押し下げた。

ただその後、国債買いが優勢になったことで利回りは低下に転じ、ＦＲＢのジェファーソン副議長が追加利上げを急ぐ必要はないとの考えを示したことを受けて一段と低下した。

サーチュイティーのスコット・ウェルチ最高投資責任者は「バリュエーションは低下したが、市場は依然として割安ではない」と指摘。「相場は緩やかに上昇を続けられるだろうが、株式、債券ともに値動きは一段と荒くなると予想している」と述べた。

原油市場では、米国が中東に部隊と空母を増派するとの報道や、中国製油各社による石油製品輸出停止を受けて北海ブレント先物が４ドル超上昇した。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１セクターではエネルギーが１．９％高で上昇率トップだった。

情報技術も堅調で、アクセンチュアの決算を受けてソフトウエア株が１％上昇した。

半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは３％高。売上高見通しが市場予想を上回ったほか、長期供給契約に基づく顧客の資金拠出約束額が３２０億ドルに増加したことも明らかにし、人工知能（ＡＩ）向けメモリー半導体の需要が衰えていないことを示した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．２３４対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０４対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７２億５０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億９０００万株。

item.title: ＦＲＢ金融政策運営に供給ショックの重要度増大＝クック理事
item.description: [１日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は１日、このところの供給ショックは予想以上に長期的な影...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ金融政策運営に供給ショックの重要度増大＝クック理事 5:22 配信

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事。カリフォルニア州オークランドで９月撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir

[１日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のクック理事は１日、このところの供給ショックは予想以上に長期的な影響を及ぼしており、ＦＲＢの金融政策運営で重要性が高まっていると述べた。

クック氏はニューヨーク連銀で開かれたイベントで、同連銀のウィリアムズ総裁と対談し「従来の見方では、金融引き締めは原油価格や戦争には効果がない一方、われわれがより懸念する雇用や生産を冷え込ませる恐れがあるため、供給ショックは見過ごされてきた」と指摘。ただ現在は、供給ショックの影響を受けるセクターなどに応じて、「最適な政策対応」が異なる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

また、人工知能（ＡＩ）による投資拡大とそれに伴うインフレ圧力が２０２７年の主要なリスクの１つになると指摘。「ＡＩ関連投資の拡大で、容易には解消しない可能性のあるインフレ圧力が生み出されている」とし、「このことが２７年について現時点で最も懸念している要因の１つになっている」と語った。

長期的にはＡＩが生産性向上につながるとの見方を示しながらも、「インフレ抑制につながる生産性向上の効果がいつ現れるのか、また次にどこで供給網のボトルネックが発生するのかを懸念している」と述べた。
